title: Collaborative generalist-specialist AI for safe worklist deprioritization of non-contrast brain computed tomography
zh_title: 通用-专用AI协同实现脑CT工作清单安全降级
summary: 多中心回顾性外部验证（n=2001）显示，通用CLIP模型与商用检测器协同可安全降级非增强脑CT检查。
key_points: 多中心外部验证2001例急诊与创伤队列
单用商用检测器漏检31例显著异常
协同系统在预设阈值下召回全部异常
reason: 同行评审+多中心外部验证且评估工作流降级效果，符合外部验证加分档，但为回顾性设计。
abstract: Safe deprioritization of non-contrast brain computed tomography (NCCT) demands high sensitivity and negative predictive value (NPV) across common and uncommon findings requiring clinical attention. Here, we present a collaborative safety net integrating BrainCT-CLIP, a generalist foundation model via contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP), with commercial detectors. Every examination remained in the reporting workflow, deprioritized only when no model returned a positive result. In a retrospective multicenter external validation of consecutive emergency and trauma cohorts ( n = 2001), standalone commercial detectors left 31 of 324 remarkable examinations deprioritized, including 16 target-disease false negatives and 15 outside their indications. In contrast, the collaborative system recovered every remarkable examination at a threshold prespecified in the development cohort, achieving 100% sensitivity and NPV while deprioritizing 18% of examinations (368/2001; 95% CI, 17–20). These findings support generalist-specialist AI for safe worklist deprioritization under radiologist oversight, with high sensitivity for intracranial findings requiring clinical attention.
zh_abstract: 对非增强脑计算机断层扫描（non-contrast brain computed tomography, NCCT）进行安全降低优先级，要求在需要临床关注的常见和不常见发现中具有高敏感性和阴性预测值（negative predictive value, NPV）。在此，我们提出一个协作式安全网，将 BrainCT-CLIP（一种通过对比语言-图像预训练（contrastive language-image pre-training, CLIP）构建的通用基础模型）与商业检测器整合。每项检查均保留在报告工作流程中，仅当没有任何模型返回阳性结果时才降低优先级。在一项针对连续急诊和创伤队列（n = 2001）的回顾性多中心外部验证中，独立商业检测器使324项显著检查中的31项被降低优先级，包括16项目标疾病假阴性和15项超出其适应证。相比之下，协作系统在开发队列中预先设定的阈值下找回了所有显著检查，达到100%敏感性和NPV，同时对18%的检查降低了优先级（368/2001；95% CI，17–20）。这些发现支持在放射科医生监督下使用通才-专科人工智能进行安全的工作列表降低优先级，并对需要临床关注的颅内发现具有高敏感性。

title: AI-driven multi-horizon risk stratification for heart failure hospitalization in UA with HFpEF: a Chinese multi-center cohort study
zh_title: AI驱动的不稳定心绞痛合并HFpEF心衰住院多时间跨度风险分层
summary: 中国多中心回顾性队列纳入4367例不稳定心绞痛合并HFpEF患者，构建12/24/36个月心衰住院风险模型并完成外部验证。
key_points: 多中心回顾性队列，纳入4367例UA合并HFpEF患者
LASSO、SVM-RFE与Boruta联合筛选预测变量
训练12种机器学习模型做多时间跨度风险预测
最优模型外部验证AUC约0.836–0.839
reason: 多中心样本4367例并完成外部验证，属重要档；回顾性设计未再上调
abstract: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) complicated by unstable angina (UA) represents a major challenge in chronic disease management with high risk of recurrent heart failure hospitalization (HFH), and despite the availability of multicenter real-world data, AI-driven tools for multi-horizon risk assessment remain limited. This multicenter retrospective cohort enrolled 4367 patients with UA and HFpEF, and an ensemble feature selection pipeline integrating LASSO, SVM-RFE and Boruta identified robust predictors, followed by training of twelve machine learning algorithms to estimate HFH risk at 12-, 24- and 36-month horizons with external validation. The optimal time-specific models (ET, GBDT and LightGBM) achieved strong discrimination in the training cohort with AUCs of 0.818, 0.834 and 0.863, and maintained performance in external validation with AUCs of 0.839, 0.836 and 0.851, respectively, while SHAP analysis highlighted diabetes mellitus, TyG-BMI and NT-proBNP as the most influential predictors. We developed and externally validated a multi-time-point machine learning framework for HFH risk stratification in UA and HFpEF, which showed acceptable calibration and potential clinical utility on decision-curve analysis. Further prospective and real-world validation across diverse populations and healthcare systems is needed to confirm clinical effectiveness and support translation into routine practice.
zh_abstract: 射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）合并不稳定型心绞痛（UA）是慢性病管理中的重大挑战，其复发性心力衰竭住院（HFH）风险高；尽管已有多个中心的真实世界数据，用于多时间跨度风险评估的人工智能驱动工具仍然有限。这项多中心回顾性队列纳入了 4367 例 UA 和 HFpEF 患者，整合 LASSO、SVM-RFE 和 Boruta 的集成特征选择流程识别出稳健预测因子，随后训练 12 种机器学习算法以估计 12、24 和 36 个月时间跨度的 HFH 风险，并进行外部验证。最佳时间特异性模型（ET、GBDT 和 LightGBM）在训练队列中实现了较强的区分能力，AUC 分别为 0.818、0.834 和 0.863，并在外部验证中保持性能，AUC 分别为 0.839、0.836 和 0.851；同时 SHAP 分析突出显示糖尿病、TyG-BMI 和 NT-proBNP 是最有影响力的预测因子。我们开发并外部验证了一个用于 UA 和 HFpEF 的 HFH 风险分层的多时间点机器学习框架，该框架在决策曲线分析中显示出可接受的校准度和潜在临床效用。仍需在不同人群和医疗系统中进行进一步的前瞻性和真实世界验证，以确认临床有效性并支持转化为常规实践。

title: External validation of an image-only ultrasound model for delivery-date prediction in four Chilean public hospitals
zh_title: 仅图像超声预测分娩日期模型在智利四院外部验证
summary: 在智利四家公立医院外部验证仅图像超声预测分娩日期模型，2550例孕妇，误差优于常规但重定标后增益不足一天。
key_points: 四院外部验证2550例孕妇
平均绝对误差6.9天 vs 常规11.6天
重定标对照下增益不足1天
reason: 四院外部验证、2550例，属重要档；但增益有限未上调至8
abstract: Pregnancy dating fails the women who need it most: those who reach care without a first-trimester scan. We externally validated a commercial image-only ultrasound deep-learning model for delivery-date prediction, applied unmodified to 64,235 frames from 3788 examinations of 2550 pregnancies (34% migrant) at four Chilean public hospitals. Mean absolute error was 6.9 days versus 11.6 for the conventional due date, yet most of this gain reflected a shorter local gestation and fell below one day against recentred comparators. Fixed-term comparators assign every pregnancy the same gestational age at birth and therefore cannot rank who will deliver early, at any level of point accuracy: accuracy metrics are blind to the ranking on which management turns whenever the outcome distribution is concentrated, as in term-dominated cohorts. In a prespecified landmark analysis the model’s separate image-only risk score discriminated preterm birth with an area under the curve of 0.86, against 0.52 for gestational age alone; outside the landmark restriction it exceeded a clinical baseline of coded diagnoses plus same-examination biometry by 0.09, although it was miscalibrated. Error and calibration were also assessed by maternal nationality. These classification analyses are exploratory, and no woman was managed with the model; they identify what a prospective study should test.
zh_abstract: 妊娠孕龄推算辜负了最需要它的女性：那些在未进行早孕期超声检查的情况下接受照护的女性。我们在智利四家公立医院对一种仅使用图像的商用超声深度学习模型进行了外部验证，用于预测分娩日期，并将该模型未经修改地应用于来自 2,550 次妊娠的 3,788 次检查的 64,235 帧图像（34% 为移民）。平均绝对误差为 6.9 天，而传统预产期为 11.6 天，然而这一增益的大部分反映的是当地更短的妊娠时长，并且相对于重新定中心的对照，差异降至不足一天。固定足月对照将每次妊娠在出生时赋予相同的孕龄，因此在任何点准确度水平上都无法对谁会早产进行排序：当结局分布集中时（如足月占主导的队列），准确度指标对管理决策所依赖的排序是盲的。在一项预设的地标分析中，该模型单独的仅图像风险评分区分早产，曲线下面积为 0.86，而单独孕龄为 0.52；在地标限制之外，它比由编码诊断加同次检查生物测量构成的临床基线高出 0.09，尽管其校准不佳。还按母亲国籍评估了误差和校准。这些分类分析是探索性的，没有女性使用该模型进行管理；它们确定了前瞻性研究应检验什么。

title: Physical Limits to AI Substitution across Physician Specialties — Implications for the Physician Workforce
zh_title: 各专科 AI 替代的物理极限与医生人力影响
summary: 基于 2023 年 Medicare Part B 约 450 亿美元、56 个专科 58.9 万名医生的申报数据，分析需要实体接触的工作占比及其对 AI 替代上限的影响。
key_points: 按是否需实体接触对申报服务分类
皮肤科、骨科等操作类专科受替代保护较强
非评估管理工作中物理性占比随培训年限上升
reason: 大样本医保索赔数据分析，提出替代上限框架；属描述性分析，非临床结局验证。
abstract: AbstractAI can already interpret medical images, draft diagnostic assessments, and converse with patients - fueling predictions that it will replace physicians. Yet software cannot physically examine, biopsy, or operate on a patient, so the share of a specialty's work that requires in-person physical interaction sets a ceiling on how much of it AI alone could replace. Analyzing 2023 Medicare Part B claims - nearly US$45 billion in payments to 589,648 physicians across 56 specialties - we classify each billed service by whether it requires physical contact, setting aside evaluation and management (E&M) visits. The share of non-E&M work that is physical, and thus protected at present from AI substitution, varies widely across specialties and increases in the length of postgraduate training: Procedural fields such as dermatology and orthopedic surgery are largely shielded. Only about one fifth of all payments go to non-E&M services with no physical barrier to AI substitution. Physicians, however, concentrate in E&M-heavy specialties - family and internal medicine - where physical protection, as we measure it, is low. The fields most accessible as career paths and most needed to relieve primary care shortages thus face the greatest uncertainty, because AI could impact their work as either a substitute or a complement - an outcome shaped as much by how AI is designed, deployed, and reimbursed as by the technology itself.
zh_abstract: 摘要 AI 已经能够解读医学图像、起草诊断评估并与患者交谈——这助长了其将取代医生的预测。然而，软件无法对患者进行体格检查、活检或手术，因此一个专科中需要面对面身体接触的工作所占比例，为 AI 单独可替代的比例设定了上限。我们分析 2023 年 Medicare Part B 索赔——向 56 个专科的 589,648 名医生支付的近 450 亿美元——按每项计费服务是否需要身体接触进行分类，并将评估与管理（E&M）就诊排除在外。非 E&M 工作中属于身体性、因而目前不受 AI 替代保护的工作占比，在不同专科间差异很大，并随毕业后培训年限增加而上升：皮肤科和骨科手术等操作性领域在很大程度上受到保护。所有支付中只有约五分之一流向没有身体接触障碍、可被 AI 替代的非 E&M 服务。然而，医生集中在 E&M 占比较高的专科——家庭医学和内科——在这些专科中，按我们的衡量，身体保护程度较低。因此，作为职业路径最容易进入、且最需要用来缓解初级保健短缺的领域面临最大不确定性，因为 AI 可能以替代或补充的方式影响它们的工作——这一结果既取决于 AI 的设计、部署和报销方式，也取决于技术本身。

title: Opposing microbiome-mediated axes link modifiable lifestyles to health and chronic diseases
zh_title: 肠道菌群介导的两条对立轴关联生活方式与疾病
summary: 基于6803名日本成人宏基因组数据，构建的菌群预测评分在13个独立队列中验证，识别出关联生活方式与15种疾病的两条对立轴。
key_points: 日本4D队列6803名成人粪便宏基因组分析
菌群预测评分在13个独立地理队列中验证
健康轴富集膳食成分代谢，疾病轴富集口腔来源菌

reason: 大队列加13队列外部验证，但AI方法非研究重点，证据方向偏流行病学
abstract: Fecal shotgun metagenomics from 6,803 adults in the Japanese 4D cohort and microbiome-based prediction scores validated across 13 independent and geographically diverse cohorts revealed two opposing microbiome-mediated axes linking lifestyle to health and 15 diseases. Analyses disentangling the role of the gut microbiome in linking lifestyle factors to health outcomes remain limited. Here, using fecal shotgun metagenomics from 6,803 adults in the Japanese 4D cohort, we identified two opposing microbiome-mediated axes linking lifestyle to health and 15 diseases. A health-associated axis enriched in microbial metabolism of dietary components was linked to plant-based, soy and dairy intake. In contrast, a disease-associated axis, enriched in oral-derived bacteria and pathobionts, was linked to refined carbohydrates and sedentary behavior. Starter culture microorganisms used to ferment foods did not show statistically significant mediation of the observed health effects. Alcohol was associated with both health- and disease-oriented mediation patterns involving microbial host-glycan utilization. Microbiome-defined health- and disease-oriented mediator axes were supported by fecal short-chain fatty acids and plasma cytokines from >1,700 individuals, revealing butyrate-associated anti-inflammatory and pro-inflammatory host profiles, respectively. Microbiome-based prediction (MADE) scores captured lifestyle–microbiome–disease mediation patterns and distinguished individual diseases across 13 independent external cohorts from the United States, China, Sweden, Russia and Australia. We identify the gut microbiome as a key mediator linking lifestyle to health and disease, providing a framework for microbiome-based assessment to guide lifestyle interventions for health promotion and disease prevention.
zh_abstract: 来自日本 4D 队列 6,803 名成人的粪便鸟枪法宏基因组学，以及在美国、中国、瑞典、俄罗斯和澳大利亚的 13 个独立且地理多样的队列中得到验证的基于微生物组的预测评分，揭示了将生活方式与健康和 15 种疾病联系起来的两个相反的微生物组介导轴。旨在厘清肠道微生物组在将生活方式因素与健康结局相联系中的作用的研究仍然有限。在此，我们利用来自日本 4D 队列 6,803 名成人的粪便鸟枪法宏基因组学，识别出两个相反的微生物组介导轴，将生活方式与健康和 15 种疾病联系起来。一个健康相关轴富集于膳食成分的微生物代谢，与植物性食物、大豆和乳制品摄入相关。相反，一个疾病相关轴富集口腔来源细菌和致病共生菌（pathobionts），与精制碳水化合物和久坐行为相关。用于发酵食物的发酵剂微生物未显示出对所观察健康效应的统计学显著中介作用。酒精与涉及微生物宿主聚糖利用的、既面向健康又面向疾病的中介模式均相关。由微生物组定义的健康导向和疾病导向中介轴得到来自 >1,700 名个体的粪便短链脂肪酸和血浆细胞因子的支持，分别揭示与丁酸相关的抗炎和促炎宿主特征。基于微生物组的预测（MADE）评分捕捉了生活方式–微生物组–疾病的中介模式，并在来自美国、中国、瑞典、俄罗斯和澳大利亚的 13 个独立外部队列中区分了各个疾病。我们将肠道微生物组确定为连接生活方式与健康和疾病的关键中介，为基于微生物组的评估提供了一个框架，以指导促进健康和预防疾病的生活方式干预。

title: Vibe Coding versus Clinical Reality
zh_title: 「氛围编程」与临床现实的落差
summary: NEJM AI 评论文章：AI 降低了医疗软件原型开发门槛，但要让产品安全合规地进入临床，仍离不开工程师、安全专家与监管专业能力。
key_points: 有心脏病介入医生借助 AI 工具开发患者支持应用并获奖
非工程背景的领域专家也能用 AI 将问题转化为可运行软件
从演示原型到合规临床产品仍需工程、安全与监管投入
文章提及欧盟 MDR、FDA 指南与 GDPR 隐私要求
reason: 观点评论类文章，按规则最高 6 分；仅作概念与监管讨论，无数据验证。
abstract: AbstractIn February 2026, a full-time interventional cardiologist placed third in a global coding competition with a postvisit patient support application called postvisit.ai. Many top participants had no formal engineering background but were domain experts who could describe a problem precisely enough for AI tools to translate it into working software. This process has been called "vibe coding." We discuss what it means and whether it has any relevance to clinical reality. Although AI tools have dramatically lowered the barrier to building a prototype, turning a working demo into a safe, regulated product ready for clinical use still very much requires engineers, security specialists, and regulatory expertise. The EU Medical Device Regulation, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration guidance on AI in healthcare, and the privacy requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act all demand professional teams and rigorous processes that no amount of vibe coding can replace. None of this should discourage physicians from building. The natural next step is for them to move from consulting on software design to actively shaping the tools that they use, creating a new generation of physician-builders.
zh_abstract: 摘要 2026年2月，一位全职介入心脏病学家凭借一款名为 postvisit.ai 的诊后患者支持应用，在一场全球编程比赛中获得第三名。许多顶尖参赛者没有正规工程背景，但他们是领域专家，能够足够精确地描述问题，使 AI 工具将其转化为可运行的软件。这一过程被称为“vibe coding”。我们讨论其含义以及它是否与临床现实相关。尽管 AI 工具已大幅降低构建原型的门槛，但将可运行的演示转化为安全、受监管、可供临床使用的产品，仍然非常需要工程师、安全专家和监管专业知识。欧盟《医疗器械法规》（EU Medical Device Regulation）、美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）关于医疗保健中人工智能的指南，以及《通用数据保护条例》（General Data Protection Regulation）和《健康保险流通与责任法案》（Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act）的隐私要求，都要求专业团队和严格流程，而这些是再多 vibe coding 也无法替代的。这不应使医生不敢动手构建。自然的下一步是让他们从软件设计咨询转向积极塑造自己使用的工具，从而创造新一代“医生-构建者”。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Gallbladder Carcinoma: A Review of Research Studies and Clinical Evidence.

abstract: [Journal of gastrointestinal cancer] Gallbladder carcinoma (GBC) is the most common biliary tract malignancy and is usually diagnosed at an advanced stage. Artificial intelligence (AI), including radiomics, machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), is increasingly applied to its diagnosis, surgical management and prognostication, but how far the reported performance can be trusted is unclear. PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library and Google Scholar were searched to 5 May 2026 using database-specific search strategies. Each primary prediction-model study was characterized separately by design, number of centers and validation type (internal, temporal or external). Of 31 primary AI studies in GBC, 29 were retrospective, 22 were single-center and 24 reported internal validation only. In independent test or external cohorts, DL and ML models discriminated benign from malignant gallbladder lesions with areas under the curve (AUCs) of approximately 0.80-0.89; a multicenter model distinguishing xanthogranulomatous cholecystitis from GBC achieved an external AUC of 0.88, and automated computed tomography (CT) segmentation an external Dice score of 0.76. The best recurrence model achieved an AUC of 0.76 on internal (random-split) validation; none of the reviewed prognostic models reported a quantified external-validation estimate. Intraoperative AI is technically feasible but has no outcome data, and federated learning has been tested only in simulation. AI could plausibly assist several steps of GBC care, but the evidence is dominated by retrospective, single-center, internally validated studies from Asia, and metrics from different studies are not directly comparable. Prospective multicenter external validation, shared annotated datasets and standardized reporting are required before clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: [Journal of gastrointestinal cancer] 胆囊癌（gallbladder carcinoma, GBC）是最常见的胆道恶性肿瘤，通常在晚期才被诊断。人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI），包括放射组学、机器学习（machine learning, ML）和深度学习（deep learning, DL），正越来越多地应用于其诊断、手术管理和预后判断，但所报告的性能在多大程度上可信尚不清楚。使用各数据库特定检索策略检索了 PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane Library 和 Google Scholar，截至2026年5月5日。每项主要预测模型研究均按设计、中心数量和验证类型（内部、时间或外部）分别进行特征描述。在31项GBC主要AI研究中，29项为回顾性研究，22项为单中心研究，24项仅报告内部验证。在独立测试或外部队列中，DL和ML模型区分胆囊良性与恶性病变的曲线下面积（areas under the curve, AUCs）约为0.80-0.89；一个区分黄色肉芽肿性胆囊炎与GBC的多中心模型达到外部AUC 0.88，自动计算机断层扫描（computed tomography, CT）分割达到外部Dice评分0.76。最佳复发模型在内部（随机拆分）验证中达到AUC 0.76；所综述的预后模型均未报告量化的外部验证估计值。术中AI技术上可行，但尚无结局数据，联邦学习仅在模拟中测试过。AI可能有助于GBC诊疗的多个步骤，但证据主要来自亚洲的回顾性、单中心、内部验证研究，且不同研究的指标不能直接比较。在临床采用前，需要前瞻性多中心外部验证、共享的注释数据集和标准化报告。

abstract: [Nature methods] De novo peptide sequencing enables peptide identification from fragmentation spectra without relying on sequence databases. However, incomplete spectra create ambiguity, making unambiguous identification challenging. Recent deep learning advances have produced numerous de novo models that predict sequences and refine peptide-spectrum matches under such conditions. Yet, their relative strengths, weaknesses and ability to handle spectrum ambiguity remain unclear. Here we benchmark eight state-of-the-art models on three publicly available proteomics datasets, comparing performance using established metrics and quantifying inter-model agreement. We assess post-processing approaches, including iterative refinement, rescoring and reranking, for their ability to improve identification accuracy, and perform an error analysis to identify common mispredictions and their causes. Model performance varied, with considerable overlap of correct identifications. Post-processing yielded no or only modest improvements. Most sequencing errors were model-independent and driven by limited fragment ion coverage, a limitation also observed in database searches with large search spaces.
zh_abstract: [Nature methods] 从头肽段测序（de novo peptide sequencing）能够在不依赖序列数据库的情况下从碎片谱中鉴定肽段。然而，不完整谱图会产生歧义，使无歧义鉴定具有挑战性。近期深度学习进展产生了众多 de novo 模型，可在此类条件下预测序列并细化肽段-谱图匹配。然而，它们相对的优势、劣势以及处理谱图歧义的能力仍不清楚。在此，我们在三个公开可用的蛋白质组学数据集上对八个最先进模型进行基准测试，使用既有指标比较性能并量化模型间一致性。我们评估后处理方法，包括迭代细化、重打分和重排序，在提高鉴定准确性方面的能力，并进行错误分析以识别常见误预测及其原因。模型性能存在差异，正确鉴定结果有相当大的重叠。后处理未带来改进或仅带来适度改进。大多数测序错误与模型无关，且由有限的碎片离子覆盖驱动，这一局限在具有大搜索空间的数据库搜索中也可观察到。

abstract: [Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft = Journal of the German Society of Dermatology : JDDG] Basal cell carcinoma (BCC) is the most common cancer and a major public health burden. Noninvasive techniques such as optical coherence tomography (OCT) may reduce unnecessary biopsies and enable earlier detection. However, effective OCT interpretation requires expertise. Artificial intelligence (AI) may help overcome this barrier. An AI model based on a U-Net convolutional neural network was trained using 4,680 annotated OCT image frames from 39 BCCs, 5,640 frames from 47 premalignant and benign lesions, and 12,360 frames from 103 scans of healthy skin. Detection performance was evaluated on an independent test set comprising 26 scans (3,120 frames) from 16 BCCs, 5 premalignant lesions, and 5 benign lesions. External validation used independent clinical data from 25 histologically confirmed BCCs (18 nodular, 7 superficial). AI-assisted OCT generated visual overlays corresponding to established BCC features and identified tumor areas. In the independent test set, the area under the ROC curve was 95.5 % for nodular and 98.2 % for superficial BCC. In clinical validation, all BCCs were detected, and subtype concordance with histology was achieved in 21 of 25 cases (83 %). AI-assisted OCT shows potential to improve non-invasive BCC diagnostics and warrants further clinical evaluation.
zh_abstract: 《Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft = Journal of the German Society of Dermatology : JDDG》 基底细胞癌（BCC）是最常见的癌症，也是重大的公共卫生负担。光学相干断层扫描（OCT）等无创技术可能减少不必要的活检并实现更早检测。然而，有效的 OCT 判读需要专业知识。人工智能（AI）可能有助于克服这一障碍。基于 U-Net 卷积神经网络的 AI 模型使用来自 39 个 BCC 的 4,680 个标注 OCT 图像帧、来自 47 个癌前和良性病变的 5,640 个帧，以及来自 103 次健康皮肤扫描的 12,360 个帧进行训练。检测性能在独立测试集上评估，该测试集包含来自 16 个 BCC、5 个癌前病变和 5 个良性病变的 26 次扫描（3,120 个帧）。外部验证使用来自 25 个组织学确诊 BCC（18 个结节型、7 个浅表型）的独立临床数据。AI 辅助 OCT 生成与既定 BCC 特征相对应的视觉叠加图，并识别肿瘤区域。在独立测试集中，结节型 BCC 的 ROC 曲线下面积为 95.5%，浅表型 BCC 为 98.2%。在临床验证中，所有 BCC 均被检出，并且在 25 例中的 21 例（83%）实现了与组织学的亚型一致性。AI 辅助 OCT 显示出改善无创 BCC 诊断的潜力，值得进一步的临床评估。

abstract: [Health education & behavior : the official publication of the Society for Public Health Education] Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is the leading cause of death in the United States and disproportionately affects racial/ethnic minoritized populations, low-income communities, older adults, and rural residents. Behavioral interventions can reduce cardiovascular risk, yet traditional programs face scalability barriers, including high costs and limited reach. This narrative review synthesizes evidence on the efficacy and equity of patient-directed AI tools that support health education and behavior change for cardiovascular health. Using PRISMA-ScR elements, we searched 10 databases (January 2010 to December 2025), yielding 19 empirical studies evaluating Generation 2.0 AI systems aligned with the American Heart Association's Life's Essential 8 (LE8) framework. Of these, five were randomized controlled trials (RCTs), and 14 were nonrandomized (quasi-experimental, observational, or early-stage) studies. AI-enabled interventions such as conversational agents, machine-learning models, and reinforcement-learning systems addressed hypertension, diabetes, heart failure, and related conditions. Among the RCTs, one demonstrated superiority of an AI-powered program over usual care (AI-delivered Diabetes Prevention Program), whereas the remaining four reported outcomes equivalent or non-inferior to standard behavioral care. Effects were most apparent in high-intensity interventions that paired machine learning-based personalization with structured behavioral curricula, although the multi-component nature of these programs limits inference about AI-specific contributions. Across nonrandomized studies, greater engagement intensity was consistently associated with improved cardiometabolic outcomes, although causal attribution to AI-specific mechanisms remains limited. Most studies had small samples, short follow-up, and limited reporting on safety and equity. Technology-intensive interventions were concentrated in higher-resourced settings, and populations with limited health literacy showed reduced engagement. Overall, evidence supports cautious optimism that AI can meaningfully scale personalized cardiovascular prevention; however, realizing that equitable and clinically meaningful impact will require rigorous trials with longer follow-up, explicit behavioral science integration, safety-conscious governance, and equity-centered strategies addressing digital determinants of health.
zh_abstract: 【健康教育与行为：公共卫生教育学会官方出版物】心血管疾病（cardiovascular disease, CVD）是美国的主要死因，并且对种族/族裔少数群体、低收入社区、老年人和农村居民造成不成比例的影响。行为干预可以降低心血管风险，但传统项目面临可扩展性障碍，包括高成本和覆盖范围有限。本叙述性综述综合了关于面向患者的 AI 工具在支持心血管健康教育及行为改变方面的有效性与公平性的证据。采用 PRISMA-ScR 要素，我们检索了 10 个数据库（2010 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月），最终纳入 19 项实证研究，这些研究评估了符合美国心脏协会 Life's Essential 8（LE8）框架的第二代（Generation 2.0）AI 系统。其中 5 项为随机对照试验（randomized controlled trials, RCTs），14 项为非随机（准实验、观察性或早期阶段）研究。AI 赋能的干预措施，如对话式智能体、机器学习模型和强化学习系统，针对高血压、糖尿病、心力衰竭及相关疾病。在 RCT 中，一项研究显示 AI 驱动的项目优于常规照护（AI 实施的糖尿病预防项目），而其余四项报告的结果与标准行为照护相当或不劣于后者。效应在高强度干预中最为明显，这些干预将基于机器学习的个性化与结构化的行为课程相结合，尽管这些项目的多组分性质限制了对 AI 特异性贡献的推断。在非随机研究中，更高的参与强度始终与改善的心脏代谢结局相关，尽管对 AI 特异性机制的因果归因仍然有限。大多数研究样本量小、随访时间短，且对安全性和公平性的报告有限。技术密集型干预集中在资源较丰富的环境中，而健康素养有限的人群参与度较低。总体而言，证据支持谨慎乐观的态度，即 AI 能够有意义地扩大个性化心血管预防的规模；然而，要实现公平且具有临床意义的影响，需要随访时间更长的严谨试验、明确的行为科学整合、注重安全的治理，以及以公平为中心、针对健康数字决定因素的战略。

abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] The 3D organization of chromatin shapes gene regulation and cellular function, and Hi-C has become the primary technique for mapping chromatin interactions genome-wide. However, high-resolution data remain costly and scarce, leaving many studies with sparse contact maps that limit downstream analysis. Deep learning methods, especially generative adversarial networks (GANs), have shown promise for enhancing low-resolution Hi-C data, but most existing GAN-based approaches rely on custom discriminators trained from scratch, which can yield unstable training and limited generalization. Hi-C foundation models pretrained on large-scale data capture rich, transferable representations of chromatin structure, yet their use as discriminators within adversarial enhancement frameworks had not been explored. We introduce HiCP2GAN, a plug-and-play GAN that employs a pretrained Vision Transformer-based Hi-C foundation model as its discriminator. The discriminator was pretrained on 118 million Hi-C patches across diverse species and cell types, providing biologically meaningful gradients for adversarial supervision. The framework is generator-agnostic: any compatible Hi-C resolution enhancement architecture can serve as the generator, enabling fair comparison across methods. The encoder phase of the foundation model was adapted as a discriminator backbone, finetuning the first few layers from the input while freezing the deeper transformer layers to preserve pretrained knowledge while allowing task-specific adaptation. Experiments across various cell lines show that HiCP2GAN outperforms traditional GAN-based methods in most settings and improves the reconstruction quality and biological reproducibility of existing Hi-C enhancement models in most evaluated cases. HiCP2GAN is publicly available at https://github.com/OluwadareLab/HiCP2GAN.
zh_abstract: 《Briefings in bioinformatics》染色质的三维组织塑造基因调控和细胞功能，Hi-C已成为全基因组范围内绘制染色质相互作用的主要技术。然而，高分辨率数据仍然昂贵且稀缺，使许多研究只能获得稀疏接触图谱，从而限制下游分析。深度学习方法，尤其是生成对抗网络（GAN），在增强低分辨率Hi-C数据方面显示出前景，但大多数现有基于GAN的方法依赖从头训练的定制判别器，这可能导致训练不稳定和泛化能力有限。Hi-C基础模型在大规模数据上预训练，可捕捉丰富、可迁移的染色质结构表征，但其在对抗增强框架中作为判别器的用途尚未被探索。我们提出HiCP2GAN，一种即插即用的GAN，采用预训练的基于Vision Transformer的Hi-C基础模型作为其判别器。该判别器在跨不同物种和细胞类型的1.18亿个Hi-C片段上预训练，为对抗监督提供具有生物学意义的梯度。该框架与生成器无关：任何兼容的Hi-C分辨率增强架构均可作为生成器，从而支持跨方法公平比较。该基础模型的编码器阶段被改造为判别器骨干，微调来自输入的前几层，同时冻结更深的Transformer层，以保留预训练知识并允许任务特定适应。在多种细胞系上的实验表明，HiCP2GAN在大多数设置中优于传统基于GAN的方法，并在大多数评估案例中提高现有Hi-C增强模型的重建质量和生物学可重复性。HiCP2GAN公开可用，网址为 https://github.com/OluwadareLab/HiCP2GAN。

title: Leakage- and Label-Aware Benchmarking of Class-Imbalance Strategies for Multimodal Chest X-Ray and EHR Classification
zh_title: 胸片与电子病历多模态分类的类别不平衡基准审计
summary: 预印本审计29,083张MIMIC-CXR影像与EHR的多模态基准，发现记录级划分存在标签泄漏，未见患者上模型性能跌至全阳性水平。
key_points: 基于10,479名患者的29,083张胸片审计
查找表复制同EHR向量标签即可近最优
标签源自单次住院诊断码关键词匹配
reason: 揭示多模态基准标签泄漏与评测缺陷，方法学价值高但为预印本
abstract: Benchmarks of class-imbalance strategies for multimodal chest X-ray (CXR) and electronic health record (EHR) prediction are often evaluated on record-level splits of cohorts in which one patient contributes several radiographs. We audit such a benchmark on 29,083 MIMIC-CXR radiographs of 10,479 patients with eight diagnosis targets. First, the record-split benchmark was misleading: a lookup table that copies the label of a development-set radiograph with the same EHR vector nearly matched the best model, and on unseen patients every model fell to the level of predicting every case positive. Second, tracing the labels back to MIMIC-IV explained why: each patient's labels are keyword matches on the diagnosis codes of a single admission, copied, with one EHR vector per patient, to all of the patient's radiographs, so about a third of the radiographs carry labels that differ from the codes of their own admission. Third, under patient-separated evaluation with admission-aligned and rule-refined labels, the initial conclusions do not hold: in the evaluated configurations no imbalance strategy raised the observed mean macro F2 over no augmentation by more than 0.01, tuned tree ensembles showed no consistent advantage over tuned logistic regression, and the released EHR variables stayed at the level of the all-positive baseline, whereas the diagnostic history available at imaging time and image embeddings exceeded it, including, with rule-refined labels, a CheXpert-trained encoder that never saw these radiographs; RAD-DINO had seen 96.6% of them during self-supervised pretraining. Adding either encoder to the diagnostic history gave no statistically significant F2 gain; exploratory AUROC gains were significant with RAD-DINO but not with DenseNet. We provide reusable diagnostics, a leakage-aware protocol and a checklist.
zh_abstract: 针对多模态胸部X线（CXR）与电子健康记录（EHR）预测的类别不平衡策略基准，常在按记录级划分的队列上评估，其中一名患者贡献多张影像。我们在29,083张MIMIC-CXR影像（来自10,479名患者，八个诊断目标）上审计了这样一个基准。第一，按记录划分的基准具有误导性：一个查找表复制具有相同EHR向量的开发集影像的标签，其表现几乎与最佳模型相当；而在未见患者上，每个模型都降至将所有病例预测为阳性的水平。第二，将标签追溯至MIMIC-IV解释了原因：每位患者的标签是对单次入院诊断代码的关键词匹配，并且每位患者一个EHR向量，被复制到该患者的所有影像上，因此约三分之一的影像携带的标签与其自身入院的代码不同。第三，在采用入院对齐和规则细化标签的患者分离评估下，初始结论不成立：在评估的配置中，没有任何不平衡策略使观察到的平均宏F2相对无增强提高超过0.01；调优的树集成相对于调优的逻辑回归未显示一致优势；发布的EHR变量仍处于全阳性基线水平，而影像时点可获得的诊断史和图像嵌入超过了该基线，包括在规则细化标签下，一个从未见过这些影像的CheXpert训练编码器；RAD-DINO在自监督预训练期间见过其中96.6%的影像。将任一编码器加入诊断史均未带来统计学显著的F2增益；探索性AUROC增益在RAD-DINO中显著，但在DenseNet中不显著。我们提供可复用的诊断工具、一种感知泄漏的协议和一份清单。

title: Deep learning screening of otoscopic images for ENT referral: development, validation and deployment of NHREF OtoScan
zh_title: 耳镜图像深度学习筛查工具OtoScan的开发验证与部署
summary: 预印本报告基于4763张耳镜图像构建以「是否转诊」为目标的深度学习筛查工具，并完成验证与部署。
key_points: 合并三个公开数据集图像，整理为12个临床类别
统一视野归一化处理，面向非专科医生转诊决策
报告概率校准并处理视频衍生数据的近重复问题
reason: 有验证与部署环节、样本量可观，但为预印本且基于公开数据，未达外部多中心档
abstract: Background. Middle and external ear disease is common and largely treatable, but accurate otoscopic interpretation requires training that is scarce outside specialist ENT services. Published deep learning models for otoscopy report high accuracy, yet most are optimised for closed set classification rather than the referral decision a non specialist actually makes, report uncalibrated probabilities, and do not report the near duplicate controls that video derived otoscopic datasets demand. We developed, validated and deployed a screening aid framed around referral rather than diagnosis. Methods. We merged 4,763 otoscopic images from 16 folders across three public datasets into 12 clinically meaningful classes. Every image was passed through a single field of view normalisation function (crop to the illuminated field, square, resize to 224 px, mask to one fixed circle) shared identically by training and inference, to remove the framing cue that otherwise identifies the source dataset. Because one source is video derived, images were grouped by cosine similarity of generic ImageNet features (threshold 0.93, joined transitively) and whole groups assigned to a single split, giving 3,326 training, 719 validation and 718 test images. A MobileNetV2 backbone initialised from ImageNet was fine tuned from block9expand. Probabilities were averaged over the eight dihedral transforms of each image and temperature scaled. The referral score was one minus the probability of a normal ear, and its threshold was set on the validation abnormal ears as the highest value still meeting a target sensitivity of 97%, applied with an inclusive comparison. Model selection, calibration and threshold were frozen before the test split was scored once. Results. On the 718 held out test images, referral sensitivity was 97.0% (95% CI 95.1 to 98.2) and specificity 75.6% (95% CI 69.4 to 80.8), with AUROC 0.974 for abnormal versus normal; a cluster bootstrap over the 363 similarity groups in the test split widens those intervals to 93.8 99.6% and 66.0 83.4% respectively. Of 501 abnormal ears, 15 were not referred; 11 of these were myringosclerosis and none was cholesteatoma. Twelve class macro F1 was 0.686, balanced accuracy 68.3%, and accuracy 85.0% (86.2% with chronic subtypes merged). Temperature scaling (T = 1.2) reduced expected calibration error from 0.0498 to 0.0430. A low confidence flag fired on 4.0% of test images, separating 87.2% accuracy on unflagged from 31.0% on flagged cases.
zh_abstract: 【背景】中耳和外耳疾病常见且大多可治疗，但准确的耳镜解读需要培训，而这种培训在专科耳鼻喉（ENT）服务之外很稀缺。已发表的耳镜深度学习模型报告了高准确度，但大多数针对闭集分类而非非专科医生实际做出的转诊决策进行优化，报告未校准的概率，并且未报告视频衍生的耳镜数据集所要求的近重复对照。我们开发、验证并部署了一种以转诊而非诊断为中心的筛查辅助工具。【方法】我们将来自三个公共数据集、16 个文件夹的 4,763 张耳镜图像合并为 12 个具有临床意义的类别。每张图像都通过同一个视野归一化函数（裁剪至照明视野、方形化、调整大小为 224 px、掩膜为一个固定圆形），该函数在训练和推理中完全相同地共享，以去除原本可识别源数据集的构图线索。由于一个来源是视频衍生的，图像按通用 ImageNet 特征的余弦相似度分组（阈值 0.93，传递合并），并将整组分配到单一数据划分，得到 3,326 张训练图像、719 张验证图像和 718 张测试图像。从 ImageNet 初始化的 MobileNetV2 骨干从 block9expand 开始微调。概率在每张图像的八种二面体变换上取平均并进行温度缩放。转诊评分为 1 减去正常耳的概率，其阈值在验证集异常耳上设定为仍满足目标灵敏度 97% 的最高值，并采用包含性比较。模型选择、校准和阈值在测试划分进行一次评分前被冻结。【结果】在 718 张留出测试图像上，转诊灵敏度为 97.0%（95% CI 95.1 至 98.2），特异度为 75.6%（95% CI 69.4 至 80.8），异常对正常的 AUROC 为 0.974；对测试划分中的 363 个相似性组进行聚类自助法，将这些区间分别扩大至 93.8% 至 99.6% 和 66.0% 至 83.4%。在 501 只异常耳中，15 只未被转诊；其中 11 只为鼓膜硬化，无一只为胆脂瘤。十二类宏平均 F1 为 0.686，平衡准确率为 68.3%，准确率为 85.0%（合并慢性亚型后为 86.2%）。温度缩放（T = 1.2）将期望校准误差从 0.0498 降至 0.0430。低置信度标记在 4.0% 的测试图像上触发，将未标记病例的 87.2% 准确率与标记病例的 31.0% 准确率区分开来。

summary: FDA清关一款仅软件模块，用于估算总睡眠时间。

title: Reclassification Is All You Missed: Surfacing Variant Reinterpretation Need in Online Health Communities at Population Scale
zh_title: 用智能体筛查在线健康社区中的基因变异重分类需求
summary: 预印本提出 PRISM 智能体流水线，在32个在线健康社区的390万帖中筛查变异重分类相关讨论并起草带免责声明的通知草稿，为不实际联系患者的演练。
key_points: 筛查390万帖，重分类相关讨论仅占0.288%
遗传专科社区6.30%，远高于一般医疗社区0.10%
发现123例候选分类差异，2014年以来增长五倍
reason: 新应用场景与百万级语料，但属预印本且无结局验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Genetic variants are routinely reclassified in ClinVar after a patient is tested, sometimes from uncertain to pathogenic, yet patient recontact is inconsistent, with no clear duty and responsibility diffused among labs, providers, and patients. Many affected people discuss their results in public online health communities that clinical recontact often does not reach. We built PRISM, an agentic large-language-model pipeline that screens these posts, checks whether the variant was later reclassified, and drafts a disclaimer-bearing outreach message, in a no-contact dry run. Across 3.9 million posts from 32 communities, agent-predicted reinterpretation-relevant discussion is rare (0.288%) but concentrated in specialist genetics communities (6.30% versus 0.10% in general medical-advice communities) and growing fivefold since 2014; PRISM surfaces 123 candidate classification differences, 5 of them from an uncertain submission to pathogenic or likely pathogenic. On a held-out set of 30 real-post drafts, a clinician judged 27 factually grounded and 15 fit to send: factual accuracy is necessary but not sufficient for clinically acceptable outreach. PRISM contributes a population-scale reinterpretation-need map with code and data to be released upon publication.
zh_abstract: 遗传变异在患者接受检测后会在ClinVar中被常规重新分类，有时从不确定性变为致病性，但患者再联系并不一致，没有明确的责任，且责任在实验室、提供者和患者之间分散。许多受影响者在公共在线健康社区中讨论其结果，而临床再联系往往无法触及这些社区。我们构建了PRISM，这是一个代理式大语言模型流程，可在无接触试运行中筛查这些帖子，检查该变异后来是否被重新分类，并起草带有免责声明的外联信息。在来自32个社区的390万条帖子中，代理预测的与重新解读相关的讨论很少（0.288%），但集中在专科遗传学社区（6.30%，而一般医疗建议社区为0.10%），并且自2014年以来增长了五倍；PRISM发现了123个候选分类差异，其中5个来自从不确定性提交变为致病性或可能致病性。在一个由30份真实帖子草稿组成的留出集中，临床医生判定27份有事实依据，15份适合发送：事实准确性是临床可接受外联的必要条件，但并非充分条件。PRISM贡献了一个人群规模的重新解读需求图谱，其代码和数据将在发表时发布。

title: Protify: A Benchmarking Platform Revealing Task Dependence and Homology Leakage in Protein Language Model Evaluation
zh_title: Protify：揭示蛋白质语言模型评测任务依赖与同源泄漏的平台
summary: 预印本发布开源基准平台 Protify，统一零样本、监督与迁移学习评测，支持35个预训练模型与61个数据集，并在 ProteinGym 上评测23个模型。
key_points: 统一低代码接口，支持35个模型、61个数据集
可自定义扩展模型与数据集版本
在 ProteinGym 上评测23个模型并指出同源泄漏问题
reason: 开源大规模基准平台有实用价值，但为预印本、无临床或湿实验验证
abstract: Protein Language Models (pLMs) have become essential tools for computational protein analysis, and the rapid proliferation of architectures, training objectives, and pretraining corpora has produced a diverse and expanding model landscape. Evaluation practices, however, remain fragmented: studies use different datasets, preprocessing pipelines, and reporting conventions, so results rarely transfer between publications. Here we introduce Protify, an open-source platform that standardizes pLM benchmarking across zero-shot, supervised, and transferlearning settings through a unified, low-code interface. Protify currently supports 35 pretrained models and 61 curated datasets and it is easy to add custom versions of each. Leveraging Protify's high throughput pipelines, we benchmarked 23 models on ProteinGym, discovering that DPLM3B is currently the top-performing self-supervised encoder. Another large-scale supervised evaluation across 32 diverse tasks, spanning enzyme classification, gene ontology annotation, protein-protein interaction, subcellular localization, and other functional properties, found that no single pLM dominated: 14 different models took the top score on at least one dataset, and the margins between the best and second-best models fell within run-to-run variability. On enzyme optimal pH prediction, a general-purpose probe pipeline matched or exceeded EpHod, a specialized model selected from 11,550 training runs, after 50 hyperparameter trials (R2 = 0.482 versus 0.425). Under a homology-controlled split of the same data, every pooled-embedding probe collapsed to near-zero R2, and only a transformer probe over full residue embeddings recovered appreciable signal (R2 = 0.248). Model rankings therefore depend as much on evaluation design as on the models themselves. Protify makes those design choices explicit, controlled, and replayable, and is freely available at https://github.com/Gleghorn-Lab/Protify.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质语言模型（Protein Language Models, pLMs）已成为计算蛋白质分析的重要工具，随着架构、训练目标和预训练语料的快速增殖，已形成多样且不断扩展的模型格局。然而，评估实践仍然碎片化：不同研究使用不同的数据集、预处理流程和报告惯例，因此结果很少能在不同出版物之间相互迁移。在此我们推出 Protify，这是一个开源平台，通过统一的低代码界面，在零样本（zero-shot）、监督学习和迁移学习等设置下标准化 pLM 基准测试。Protify 目前支持 35 个预训练模型和 61 个精选数据集，并且很容易添加各自的自定义版本。利用 Protify 的高通量流程，我们在 ProteinGym 上对 23 个模型进行了基准测试，发现 DPLM3B 是目前表现最佳的自监督编码器。另一项大规模监督评估覆盖 32 项多样化任务，涵盖酶分类、基因本体注释、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用、亚细胞定位及其他功能特性，结果发现没有任何单一 pLM 占据主导：14 个不同模型在至少一个数据集上取得最高分，且最佳模型与次佳模型之间的差距落在运行间变异范围内。在酶最适 pH 预测任务上，一个通用探针流程在 50 次超参数试验后，达到或超过了从 11,550 次训练运行中选出的专用模型 EpHod（R2 = 0.482 对 0.425）。在相同数据的同源控制划分下，所有池化嵌入探针的 R2 均跌至接近零，只有基于完整残基嵌入的 transformer 探针恢复了可观的信号（R2 = 0.248）。因此，模型排名既取决于模型本身，也同样取决于评估设计。Protify 使这些设计选择显式化、可控且可重放，并可在 https://github.com/Gleghorn-Lab/Protify 免费获取。

title: How Deep is the Signal? Time-Context up to 30 Years for Colorectal Cancer Prediction in a Primary-Care EHR Model
zh_title: 结直肠癌预测的 EHR 模型时间回溯窗口可达30年
summary: 预印本在伦敦西北部360万基层患者14亿编码事件上预训练 EHR 基础模型，评估2至30年回溯窗口对结直肠癌预测的影响。
key_points: 3460万参数模型，预训练于14亿编码事件
固定队列1008例病例与9582例匹配对照
15个嵌套回溯窗口下均在同一批患者内比较
reason: 大样本回顾性预印本，有系统对照但无外部验证或前瞻设计
abstract: EHR foundation models read medical events within a fixed context window, and long context has so far been measured only in tokens. How far back in time a model must look to capture the earliest predictive signal is unknown. We introduce time-context, the calendar lookback window before the prediction point, and provide, to our knowledge, the first systematic evaluation of decade-scale time-context for an EHR foundation model. We pretrained a decoder-only transformer (34.6M parameters) on 1.4B coded events from 3.6M primary-care patients in North West London and fine-tuned it to predict incident colorectal cancer under a 12-month pre-diagnostic buffer. A frozen cohort of 1,008 cases and 9,582 matched controls, all registered for at least 30 years, was evaluated at 15 nested lookback windows from 2 to 30 years, so that every truncation is compared within the same patients. Discrimination rose from an AUROC of 0.551 at 2 years to 0.590 at 18 years, then plateaued, with about 80% of the gain reached within 10 years; an XGBoost baseline converged to the same level (peak AUROC 0.589). A simulation further suggests that rotary position embeddings (RoPE) over elapsed time alias beyond about 20 years at the default base frequency, motivating a retuned $θ$. Time-context is a measurable design axis for clinical prediction models, distinct from token-context, and should be reported.
zh_abstract: 电子健康记录（EHR）基础模型在固定的上下文窗口内读取医疗事件，而长上下文迄今仅以 token 数衡量。模型必须回溯多长时间才能捕获最早的预测信号尚不清楚。我们引入了时间上下文（time-context），即预测点之前的日历回溯窗口，并据我们所知，首次对 EHR 基础模型的十年尺度时间上下文进行了系统评估。我们在来自伦敦西北部 360 万基层医疗患者的 14 亿条编码事件上预训练了一个仅解码器 transformer（3460 万参数），并在 12 个月诊断前缓冲期的设置下对其进行微调，以预测新发结直肠癌。一个冻结队列包含 1,008 例病例和 9,582 名匹配对照，所有个体注册时间至少 30 年，在从 2 年到 30 年的 15 个嵌套回溯窗口上进行评估，从而使每一次截断都在同一批患者内部进行比较。判别能力从 2 年时的 AUROC 0.551 上升至 18 年时的 0.590，随后趋于平台期，约 80% 的增益在 10 年内即已实现；XGBoost 基线收敛至相同水平（峰值 AUROC 0.589）。一项模拟进一步表明，在默认基频下，基于经过时间的旋转位置嵌入（rotary position embeddings, RoPE）在约 20 年以上会出现混叠，这促使我们重新调整了 $θ$。时间上下文是临床预测模型一个可测量的设计轴，与 token 上下文不同，应予以报告。

title: A protein language model for domain, functional site, and variant effect prediction
zh_title: PALM：预测蛋白结构域、功能位点与变异效应的蛋白语言模型
summary: 预印本发布 PALM，基于 ESM2+LoRA 与 BiLSTM，在约1500万条序列上联合预测蛋白结构域与功能位点。
key_points: 训练数据约1500万条 InterPro 注释 UniRef50 序列
覆盖17951个结构域类与1383个位点类
230万条留出蛋白上 F1 分别为0.941与0.877
reason: 预印本新方法，训练规模大并有留出集与低同源评估，属值得一看上限档
abstract: Protein sequence databases are growing far faster than experimentally curated annotations, limiting functional interpretation of newly identified proteins and coding variants. We developed PALM, a protein annotation language model that jointly predicts domain and functional-site occurrence, while preserving overlapping and nested annotations through a soft-target objective. PALM integrates ESM2 with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), learned layer aggregation, and a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) encoder. PALM was trained on ~15 million InterPro-annotated UniRef50 sequences spanning 17,951 domain and 1,383 site classes. Across 2.3 million held-out proteins, PALM achieved domain- and site-occurrence F1 scores of 0.941 and 0.877, respectively, and retained substantial performance in proteins with <20% sequence identity to the training and validation data. PALM also substantially outperformed ESM3 annotation baseline. Without training on variant-pathogenicity labels, PALM embedding disruption distinguished 151,823 ClinVar missense variants more accurately than ESM2 embedding disruption (AUROC 0.835 versus 0.710), and combining PALM embedding disruption with the ESM2 likelihood-ratio signal reached an AUROC of 0.877. The same combined zero-shot score outperformed AlphaMissense on a benchmark dataset on 128,161 missense variants, that were derived from literature but not present in ClinVar database. At the protein level, PALM embeddings showed stronger CATH-Gene3D superfamily organization than frozen ESM2 and ESM3 embeddings, and improved prediction of experimental activation and repression effects when combined with ESM2. In a downstream case study, we demonstrated the ability to use PALM-derived embedding as proxy of deep mutational scanning (DMS), showcasing the broad application of PALM. Together, PALM converts curated residue-level knowledge into transferable and mechanistically interpretable representations that connect protein sequence, function, and variant consequence.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质序列数据库的增长速度远超经实验人工整理的注释，这限制了对新鉴定蛋白质和编码变体的功能解读。我们开发了 PALM，一种蛋白质注释语言模型，它通过软目标（soft-target）目标函数联合预测结构域和功能位点的出现，同时保留重叠和嵌套注释。PALM 将 ESM2 与低秩适配（LoRA）、可学习层聚合以及双向长短期记忆（BiLSTM）编码器相整合。PALM 在约 1500 万条经 InterPro 注释的 UniRef50 序列上训练，涵盖 17,951 个结构域类别和 1,383 个位点类别。在 230 万条留出蛋白质上，PALM 的结构域出现和位点出现 F1 分数分别为 0.941 和 0.877，并且在与其训练和验证数据序列一致性 <20% 的蛋白质中仍保持显著性能。PALM 还大幅优于 ESM3 注释基线。在未使用变异致病性标签训练的情况下，PALM 嵌入扰动区分 151,823 个 ClinVar 错义变异比 ESM2 嵌入扰动更准确（AUROC 0.835 对 0.710），而将 PALM 嵌入扰动与 ESM2 似然比信号结合后，AUROC 达到 0.877。相同的组合零样本评分在一个包含 128,161 个错义变异的基准数据集上优于 AlphaMissense，这些变异源自文献但未出现在 ClinVar 数据库中。在蛋白质水平上，PALM 嵌入显示出比冻结的 ESM2 和 ESM3 嵌入更强的 CATH-Gene3D 超家族组织，并且在与 ESM2 结合时改善了对实验性激活和抑制效应的预测。在一项下游案例研究中，我们展示了将 PALM 衍生的嵌入用作深度突变扫描（DMS）代理的能力，展示了 PALM 的广泛应用。总之，PALM 将人工整理的残基水平知识转化为可迁移且机制可解释的表征，将蛋白质序列、功能和变异后果联系起来。

title: Harnessing catalytic knowledge to guide enzyme discovery and evolution with AlphaEnzyme
zh_title: AlphaEnzyme：催化知识驱动的酶发现与进化
summary: bioRxiv预印本发布结构锚定的酶基础模型，可同时读出催化兼容性、动力学与突变响应。
key_points: 时间切分基准上top-1酶检索成功率30.1%，最强基线17.2%
与训练集同源性≤40%的酶，Km预测秩相关达0.64
16个候选内富集高适应度TrpB变体
reason: 预印本具新方法与强基线对比，但未经同行评审，属值得一看档
abstract: Retrieving an enzyme for a target reaction provides a starting point for evolution, but predicting how to improve it remains difficult. This requires connecting evolutionary information with the structural and chemical context of catalysis. Here we present AlphaEnzyme, an enzyme foundation model built on a structure-grounded representation of an enzyme paired with its reaction, from which catalytic compatibility, kinetics and mutational response are read out together. On a time-separated benchmark, AlphaEnzyme achieves a top-1 catalyst retrieval success rate of 30.1%, against 17.2% for the strongest baseline. Michaelis constant predictions achieve the highest rank correlations among the compared methods, reaching 0.64 for enzymes sharing at most 40% identity with the kinetic training set. The model also enriches high-fitness TrpB variants at a budget of 16 candidates without target-specific fitness training. In prospective transaminase engineering, several prioritized variants exceed the parent, with the best design yielding a 30.4-fold increase in product signal in a lysate-based assay while retaining (R)-selectivity. Together, AlphaEnzyme provides a common molecular basis for selecting starting enzymes and prioritizing sequence changes for their improvement.
zh_abstract: 为目标反应检索一种酶为进化提供了起点，但预测如何改进它仍然困难。这需要将进化信息与催化的结构和化学背景联系起来。在此，我们提出 AlphaEnzyme，一种酶基础模型，其建立在将酶与其反应配对的结构接地表征之上，可从中共同读出催化相容性、动力学和突变响应。在一个时间分离基准上，AlphaEnzyme 的 top-1 催化剂检索成功率达到 30.1%，而最强基线为 17.2%。米氏常数预测在比较方法中获得最高的秩相关，对于与动力学训练集共享至多 40% 同一性的酶达到 0.64。该模型还在 16 个候选的预算下富集高适应度 TrpB 变体，且无需目标特异性适应度训练。在前瞻性转氨酶工程中，若干优先变体优于亲本，最佳设计在基于裂解液的检测中使产物信号增加 30.4 倍，同时保留 (R)-选择性。总之，AlphaEnzyme 为选择起始酶并优先考虑用于其改进的序列改变提供了共同的分子基础。

title: SAFE-Teen: Evaluating Chatbot Safety Across Adolescent Mental Health Conversations
zh_title: SAFE-Teen：青少年心理健康对话机器人安全评估
summary: 预印本以临床医生参与的方式评估18个聊天机器人API在32,555段模拟青少年对话中的安全性。
key_points: 覆盖18个聊天机器人API、32,555段模拟对话
含106个情景的983个变体与22项安全标准
无青少年感知系统提示时标准失败率43.3%
reason: 大规模多API安全评测且有临床医生参与，但为预印本，属值得一看上限
abstract: Adolescents are increasingly turning to AI chatbots for mental health support, advice, and companionship, raising safety concerns. While recent evaluations have started to examine safety across multiple conversational turns, few compare how slight changes in a teen's responses can affect a chatbot's safety in the same scenario. We conduct a clinician-informed evaluation of chatbot safety in simulated conversations with adolescents aged 13-17, examining how safety failures vary with adolescents' responses and teen-aware system prompting. We evaluated 32,555 simulated conversations across 18 chatbot APIs and two system-prompt conditions using 22 safety criteria grounded in previously identified harms. Conversations spanned 983 variants of 106 seed scenarios covering urgent safety issues, health advice, and identity and relationships. The overall criterion failure rate was 43.3% without the teen-aware prompt and 24.9% with it. The teen-aware prompt reduced failures, but it didn't eliminate them. When a teenager pushed back on a chatbot's answer, failures on mental health diagnosis, medication, and substance misuse boundaries rose by 10-12 percentage points without the prompt, for more than 80% of chatbots. These findings reveal persistent safety failures in simulated adolescent-chatbot interactions and show that safety depends on how a conversation unfolds.
zh_abstract: 青少年越来越多地转向AI聊天机器人寻求心理健康支持、建议和陪伴，这引发了安全担忧。尽管近期评估已开始考察多个对话轮次中的安全性，但很少有研究比较青少年回答的轻微变化会如何影响同一场景中聊天机器人的安全性。我们开展了一项由临床医生参与指导的评估，考察聊天机器人在与13-17岁青少年模拟对话中的安全性，分析安全失败如何随青少年的回答和具有青少年意识的系统提示而变化。我们使用22项基于既往已识别伤害的安全性标准，评估了跨18个聊天机器人API和两种系统提示条件的32,555段模拟对话。对话涵盖106个种子场景的983个变体，涉及紧急安全问题、健康建议以及身份与关系。总体标准失败率在没有青少年意识提示时为43.3%，有该提示时为24.9%。青少年意识提示减少了失败，但并未消除失败。当青少年反驳聊天机器人的回答时，在没有该提示的情况下，心理健康诊断、药物和物质滥用边界方面的失败在超过80%的聊天机器人中上升了10-12个百分点。这些发现揭示了模拟青少年-聊天机器人互动中持续存在的安全失败，并表明安全性取决于对话如何展开。

title: Machine Learning for Live-Birth Prediction After IVF/ICSI From Structured Clinical Data: A Systematic Review, Meta-Analysis, and Critical Appraisal
zh_title: IVF/ICSI活产预测的机器学习系统综述与meta分析
summary: 预印本按PRISMA与PROBAST+AI系统评价48项IVF/ICSI活产预测模型，内部验证合并AUC 0.814，外部验证降至0.756。
key_points: 纳入48项研究并按模型族与验证设计归类
仅内部验证合并AUC为0.814
外部或后时段验证降至0.756
强调决策点、终点与数据源界定
reason: 大样本系统综述含外部验证分层，但为预印本、无新原始数据
abstract: Machine-learning models predicting live birth after in vitro fertilisation (IVF) or intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) from routine clinical data report performance from near chance to near perfect. We systematically reviewed these models under PRISMA 2020, searching OpenAlex, Scopus and Web of Science to 22 October 2026, appraised them with PROBAST+AI and TRIPOD+AI, and pooled their discrimination with random-effects meta-analysis on the logit scale. We define what fixes the meaning of a model's output (decision point, endpoint, unit of analysis, data source) and map the 48 included studies by model family, decision point and validation design. Models evaluated only internally pooled to an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.814, against 0.756 (95% prediction interval 0.546-0.889) for models evaluated on a later period or another centre, and 0.764 for studies not at high risk of bias; neither difference was significant, and heterogeneity was extreme. Models whose decision point was not stated pooled to 0.910, the only significant moderator in meta-regression. Against logistic regression fitted to the same data, the best machine-learning model gained a pooled 0.056 AUC (95% CI 0.017-0.090). Of 48 studies, 47 were at high or unclear risk of bias, only four assessed the calibration slope, and no model has evidence of clinical impact. The certainty of the pooled evidence is low to very low; the gains that survive validation came from staging predictions to decision points and local calibration, not deeper architectures. We provide a TRIPOD+AI-mapped checklist, a benchmark specification and a research agenda.
zh_abstract: 预测体外受精（IVF）或卵胞浆内单精子注射（ICSI）后活产的机器学习模型，基于常规临床数据报告的性能从接近随机到接近完美不等。我们按照PRISMA 2020系统综述了这些模型，检索OpenAlex、Scopus和Web of Science至2026年10月22日，使用PROBAST+AI和TRIPOD+AI对其进行评价，并在logit尺度上通过随机效应荟萃分析合并其区分度。我们界定了决定模型输出含义的因素（决策点、终点、分析单位、数据来源），并按模型家族、决策点和验证设计对48项纳入研究进行映射。仅进行内部评估的模型合并的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.814，而在较晚时间段或另一中心评估的模型为0.756（95%预测区间0.546-0.889），非高偏倚风险研究为0.764；两个差异均不显著，且异质性极高。未说明决策点的模型合并为0.910，这是荟萃回归中唯一显著的调节因素。与拟合相同数据的逻辑回归相比，最佳机器学习模型合并AUC增益为0.056（95% CI 0.017-0.090）。48项研究中，47项存在高或不明确偏倚风险，仅4项评估了校准斜率，且没有任何模型有临床影响证据。合并证据的确定性为低至极低；经验证后仍存在的获益来自将预测按决策点分层以及局部校准，而非更深的网络架构。我们提供了一份按TRIPOD+AI映射的清单、一份基准规范和一份研究议程。

title: Towards Scalable Diagnostic-Driven Whole-Slide Image Retrieval for Pathology Archives
zh_title: 面向病理档案的可扩展全切片图像检索
summary: 提出CLEAR-WSI框架，用固定长度全切片嵌入实现无需元数据的病理图像检索，并在公开与临床数据上验证。
key_points: 以固定长度嵌入替代手工索引流程
在公开与临床数据上验证
预印本，尚未经同行评审
reason: 新方法含公开与临床数据验证，但为预印本且缺量化对比
abstract: The growing adoption of digital pathology has rapidly expanded collections of hematoxylin-and-eosin whole-slide images, yet efficient navigation through these archives remains challenging, as metadata is often inconsistent or unavailable. Content-based image retrieval addresses this challenge by identifying similar cases directly from visual representations instead of manual annotations or metadata. Existing retrieval systems have demonstrated promising performance but largely rely on handcrafted indexing pipelines and predefined sampling strategies, constraining scalability and generalization. Here, we present CLEAR-WSI (Constant-Length Embedding for Automatic Retrieval of Whole-Slide Images) as a scalable, diagnostic-driven slide-retrieval framework, validated on both public and clinical data. Using a fixed-length slide embedding, CLEAR-WSI refines retrieved candidates with either a predicted diagnostic label or the ground-truth label, depending on the retrieval setting. Newly processed cases are subsequently added to the expanding memory bank, allowing the retrieval archive to grow over time. On a comprehensive benchmark consisting of two public and one private clinical datasets representing four retrieval tasks, CLEAR-WSI improves Precision@5 over the strongest evaluated baseline, with gains on CAMELYON16 (3.10), BRACS-1 (2.75), BRACS-2 (1.95), and X-HER2 (3.75). Additional ablation and latency studies further examine the contribution of each component and highlight its potential for scalable deployment.
zh_abstract: 数字病理学的日益普及迅速扩大了苏木精-伊红（hematoxylin-and-eosin）全切片图像集合，但高效浏览这些档案仍具挑战性，因为元数据常常不一致或不可获得。基于内容的图像检索通过直接从视觉表征中识别相似病例，而非依赖人工标注或元数据，来应对这一挑战。现有检索系统已表现出有前景的性能，但在很大程度上依赖手工设计的索引流程和预定义采样策略，限制了可扩展性和泛化能力。在此，我们提出CLEAR-WSI（Constant-Length Embedding for Automatic Retrieval of Whole-Slide Images），作为一种可扩展、诊断驱动的切片检索框架，并在公共和临床数据上进行了验证。CLEAR-WSI使用固定长度切片嵌入，根据检索设置，用预测诊断标签或真实标签对检索到的候选进行细化。新处理的病例随后被加入不断扩展的记忆库，使检索档案能够随时间增长。在由两个公共数据集和一个私有临床数据集组成、代表四项检索任务的综合基准上，CLEAR-WSI将Precision@5相对于所评估的最强基线提高，在CAMELYON16（3.10）、BRACS-1（2.75）、BRACS-2（1.95）和X-HER2（3.75）上均取得增益。额外的消融和延迟研究进一步考察了各组成部分的贡献，并突显了其可扩展部署的潜力。

title: LungMend: A Healthy-Only Latent Diffusion Shape Prior for Lung Mask Correction in Severe Tuberculosis CT
zh_title: LungMend：以健康肺先验扩散模型修正重症结核CT肺掩膜
summary: 预印本提出用仅基于健康肺训练的潜扩散后处理模型修正重症结核CT的肺分割掩膜，并开源代码。
key_points: 用健康解剖先验，无需病理数据或CT强度
可找回R231漏掉的空洞与实变
在专家标注切片上准确率提升，代码已开源
reason: 新方法清晰、与基线对比并开源代码，但仅内部标注评估，属预印本值得一看档。
abstract: Lung segmentation models such as R231 are widely used, but they fail on severe tuberculosis (TB) CT: cavities and consolidations look like non-lung tissue and are left out of the mask. We present LungMend, a post-processing model that corrects such masks using only healthy anatomy. A latent diffusion model, trained on healthy lungs with synthetically corrupted masks, learns to recover the complete lung from the faulty mask and the bone anatomy, without any pathological data or CT intensities. LungMend recovers cavities and consolidations that R231 misses and improves accuracy on expert-annotated slices. Code: https://github.com/noureddinekhiati/LungMend
zh_abstract: 诸如 R231 之类的肺部分割模型被广泛使用，但它们在严重结核病（TB）CT 上失败：空洞和实变看起来像非肺组织，因而被排除在掩膜之外。我们提出 LungMend，一种仅使用健康解剖结构来校正此类掩膜的后处理模型。一个在健康肺上训练、并使用人工损坏掩膜的潜在扩散模型，学会从错误掩膜和骨骼解剖结构恢复完整肺，且不使用任何病理数据或 CT 强度。LungMend 恢复了 R231 遗漏的空洞和实变，并提高了在专家标注切片上的准确率。代码：https://github.com/noureddinekhiati/LungMend

title: Hallucinations in generative LLMs for radiology: a comprehensive review.
source: PubMed · Current problems in diagnostic radiology
zh_title: 放射学生成式大模型幻觉综述
summary: 综述梳理放射学领域生成式大语言模型产生幻觉的路径，涉及模型架构、数据质量、黑箱性与自动化偏见及防控策略。
key_points: 幻觉被视为放射学新兴安全风险
归因架构、数据质量与黑箱不透明
自动化偏见可能放大解释误差
提出数据治理、可解释与模拟框架等对策
reason: 综述类文章按上限6分，主题重要但无原始数据，取5分
abstract: [Current problems in diagnostic radiology] Hallucinations generated by large language models (LLMs) represent an emerging safety top event in radiology, where subtle interpretive errors can rapidly propagate into clinical decisions. Although these systems demonstrate remarkable linguistic fluency, their underlying probabilistic architecture is, in some cases, not aligned with the demands of diagnostic intelligence, factual reliability, or safety standards. This work presents a comprehensive review describing the pathways that lead to hallucinations in radiology domain generative LLMs, mapping the risks derived from model architecture, data quality, black-box opacity, and automation bias. It also identifies the preventive strategies required to control these risks, including legal and governance safeguards, rigorous data curation protocols, explainability and simulation frameworks, and structured human oversight. This review shows how hallucinations may distort diagnostic reasoning, generate fictitious clinical data, and precipitate erroneous management decisions with potential patient harm, underscoring the need for controlled deployment strategies before integrating generative AI into radiological workflows.
zh_abstract: 【诊断放射学当前问题】大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）产生的幻觉代表了放射学中一个新出现的安全顶级事件，其中细微的解释错误可迅速传播到临床决策中。尽管这些系统表现出显著的语言流畅性，但其底层概率架构在某些情况下与诊断智能、事实可靠性或安全标准的要求不一致。这项工作提供了一篇全面综述，描述了放射学领域生成式 LLM 中导致幻觉的路径，映射了源自模型架构、数据质量、黑箱不透明性和自动化偏倚的风险。它还确定了控制这些风险所需的预防策略，包括法律和治理保障、严格的数据管理协议、可解释性和模拟框架，以及结构化的人工监督。本综述展示了幻觉如何扭曲诊断推理、生成虚构的临床数据，并促成可能对患者造成伤害的错误管理决策，强调了在将生成式 AI 整合到放射学工作流程之前需要受控部署策略。

title: Therapeutic Functions in Large Language Model Responses to Emotional Disclosures: Qualitative Content Analysis.
zh_title: 大模型对情绪披露回应的治疗性功能分析
summary: 用三个大模型生成54条模拟情绪困扰输入，质性分析前沿大模型回应是否类似既有治疗实践。
key_points: 54条模拟输入覆盖3种长度与5种表达语域
输入由GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7与Gemini生成
考察回应模式是否体现自我觉察相关治疗实践
reason: 同行评审质性内容分析，输入为模拟数据，属值得一看档
abstract: [JMIR formative research] Millions of people now use general-purpose large language models (LLMs) for mental health support, yet how these models respond to emotional disclosures and whether their responses functionally resemble established therapeutic practices remain uncharacterized. This study aimed to characterize how frontier LLMs respond to emotionally charged messages and examine whether their response patterns resemble therapeutic practices associated with self-awareness. We generated 54 simulated user inputs representing mild-to-moderate everyday emotional difficulties. These simulated user inputs were generated using 3 LLMs (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, and Gemini 2.5 Pro). The simulated user inputs systematically varied across 3 lengths and 5 communicative registers, ranging from raw venting to pragmatic requests. Then, each simulated user input was presented as a standalone user turn to the same 3 frontier LLMs, yielding 162 responses. Two independent clinical coders qualitatively coded the resulting responses using an inductive approach. The codes were compared and consolidated through iterative consensus, which yielded 8 higher-order categories. Acknowledging and validating segments appeared in 89.5% (145/162) of responses, emotion-focused suggestions in 84.6% (137/162), and interpretation in 67.3% (109/162). These patterns converged on emotional self-awareness, a construct associated with adaptive emotion regulation, suggesting that LLMs may repeatedly enact a recognizable micro-process of validation, affect labeling, interpretation, reflection, and regulation support. Models differed in stance, with some assigning emotional labels and interpretations directly rather than prompting users' own reflection. Frontier LLMs respond to emotional disclosures in patterned, largely convergent ways that approximate therapeutic techniques for building emotional awareness, though delivered more didactically than in clinical practice. Whether these responses build genuine self-awareness, reduce symptoms, or provide therapeutic benefit requires controlled and naturalistic investigation.

abstract: [European journal of pediatrics] Artificial intelligence (AI) is reaching pediatric practice through consumer apps, wearables and decision-support tools, yet most children with allergic disease are managed by general pediatricians. This review summarizes what AI can and cannot do across pediatric allergic diseases, emphasising clinical readiness and the questions clinicians should ask before acting on an algorithmic output. Narrative review. MEDLINE/PubMed, Scopus and Google Scholar were searched for English-language publications (January 2015-June 2026) on machine learning, deep learning, digital biomarkers and large language models in pediatric asthma, wheeze, atopic dermatitis, food allergy and allergic rhinitis. Peer-reviewed studies were appraised for clinical applicability, validation status and implementation barriers. Machine learning trajectory analyses show that allergic disease follows multiple coexisting pathways rather than a single atopic march. Deep learning interprets atopic dermatitis images and respiratory sounds with accuracy approaching specialist assessment. Predictive models estimate oral food challenge outcomes and impending asthma exacerbations, and wearable-derived biomarkers may signal deterioration early. Readiness nevertheless varies widely: most applications remain at research or pilot stage, constrained by small single-center datasets, scarce external validation, under-representation of darker skin tones, and limited interoperability with clinical workflows. AI is closer to the bedside in pediatric allergy than in many other areas of pediatrics, but few tools are ready for autonomous clinical use. No trial has yet shown that acting on an AI-derived risk estimate improves clinical outcomes in children. Pediatricians will increasingly encounter AI-derived outputs brought by families or embedded in health systems; appraising validation, representativeness and accountability is becoming a core clinical skill. • Pediatric allergic diseases follow heterogeneous trajectories that conventional tools predict poorly. • AI models report high accuracy in image, audio, and risk-prediction tasks. • Readiness, not reported accuracy, should govern clinical use: most tools remain research-stage. • Pediatricians need a practical framework to appraise AI outputs brought by families and health systems.

abstract: [Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine] BackgroundMedical image segmentation is a fundamental step in computer-aided diagnosis and treatment planning, and its research landscape has expanded rapidly with the advancement of artificial intelligence. A systematic bibliometric overview of this field is therefore needed to clarify its intellectual structure and emerging trends.ObjectiveTo provide a comprehensive bibliometric overview of the global research landscape, developmental trends, collaboration networks, and emerging hotspots in the field of medical image segmentation over the past decade.MethodsA bibliometric analysis was performed on 21,437 publications related to medical image segmentation, indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection from 2016 to 2025. The analysis systematically examined publication outputs, country-level contributions, author collaboration networks, journal distributions, and keyword co-occurrence patterns.ResultsThe annual publication count increased remarkably from 25 in 2016 to 5,207 in 2025. China contributed the largest share with 11,556 publications, followed by the United States (3,272) and India (1,924). Core researchers formed stable intra-team collaborations, though inter-team cooperation remained limited. Keyword and citation analyses identified deep learning, convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Transformers, U-Net, and their variants as dominant methodological themes. Case studies on skin and lung segmentation revealed differential research attention and international collaboration patterns across anatomical targets. A historical trajectory analysis showed methodological evolution from traditional image processing to fully convolutional networks and U-Net, and subsequently to hybrid architectures integrating attention mechanisms and Transformers.ConclusionMedical image segmentation has experienced substantial growth, driven by deep learning innovations. Future research may increasingly focus on multimodal foundation models capable of generalizable segmentation across diverse clinical scenarios. This bibliometric review offers researchers a valuable reference for understanding the intellectual structure and frontiers of the field.

abstract: [Nature] Cancer cells show highly heterogeneous and plastic states in glioblastoma, an incurable brain tumour1-5. However, how these malignant states arise and whether they follow defined cellular trajectories across tumours is poorly understood. Here we generated a deep single-cell and spatial multi-omic atlas of human glioblastoma that pairs transcriptomic, epigenomic and genomic profiling of 12 tumours across many regions. We identify that glioblastoma heterogeneity is driven by spatially patterned transitions of cancer cells from developmental-like states towards those defined by a glial injury response and hypoxia. This cellular trajectory regionalizes tumours into distinct tissue microenvironments and manifests in a molecularly conserved manner across tumours as well as genetically distinct tumour subclones. Consistently, using a new deep-learning framework to map cancer cell states jointly with clones in situ, we show that tumour subclones are finely spatially intermixed through glioblastoma tissue microenvironments. We validate this cellular trajectory by using somatic mutation-based hierarchies in vivo and an experimental patient-derived organoid model ex vivo. Finally, we show that this cancer cell trajectory is intimately linked to myeloid heterogeneity and unfolds across regionalized myeloid signalling environments. Our findings define a stereotyped trajectory of cancer cells in glioblastoma and unify glioblastoma tumour heterogeneity into a tractable cellular and tissue framework.

abstract: [Journal of neuroradiology = Journal de neuroradiologie] Artificial intelligence (AI) is used in brain arteriovenous malformation (AVM) neuroimaging, but translation readiness remains incompletely mapped. To characterize AI-related applications, reported performance, and barriers to clinical deployment. We conducted a PRISMA-ScR-guided review of PubMed, Embase, and Google Scholar from inception through 20 December 2025, with PubMed additionally searched on 23 August 2026. Eligible sources addressed AI, machine learning, radiomics, or automated computational analysis of brain AVM imaging. Results were charted descriptively; heterogeneous metrics were not pooled. Thirty-two sources were included: 28 primary reports and four contextual evidence syntheses. Thirteen primary reports had a documented AI/ML component. Of these, seven used imaging-derived inputs only, three combined imaging with clinical or treatment predictors, one compared separate imaging and clinical models, and two had unresolved final predictor sets. Three nidus-segmentation reports gave Dice estimates of 0.754, 0.80 and 0.82; partition details were unavailable for the first, and the last applied to detected lesions. Validation designs and clinical targets varied, precluding a pooled performance estimate. AI/ML shows technical feasibility in selected brain AVM imaging and prediction tasks. Clinical benefit and routine deployment have not been demonstrated. Multicenter institutional validation, calibration, transparent reporting and prospective clinical-impact evaluation remain priorities.

abstract: [Biomedical microdevices] Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) necessitates rapid and reliable diagnostic technologies to support timely antimicrobial selection and stewardship. Although conventional culture-based antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST) remains clinically important, its extended turnaround time limits timely intervention, while molecular diagnostics can rapidly identify resistance determinants but may not accurately predict phenotypic resistance. This review critically examines the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) with biomedical microdevices and biosensors for rapid AMR detection, encompassing microfluidic and lab-on-chip platforms, electrochemical and optical biosensors, and CRISPR-based technologies. Emphasis is placed on the application of AI for signal processing, noise reduction, pattern recognition, multiplexed detection, and predictive interpretation of complex biosensor outputs. Key translational challenges, including biofouling, matrix interference, sample-preparation variability, bubble formation, evaporation, signal drift, invalid-test rates, device reproducibility, and inadequate standardisation of reporting and validation, are critically evaluated. The requirements for embedded AI, including memory, computational resources, latency, and energy efficiency, are also considered for portable point-of-care deployment. Analytical, clinical, and operational validation are distinguished, with emphasis on prospective multicentre evaluation using representative specimens and reference AST methods. Beyond clinical diagnosis, AI-enabled microdevices offer potential for decentralised AMR surveillance across wastewater, agricultural, veterinary, and environmental settings within a One Health framework. Translation will require standardised datasets, generalisable and explainable AI, scalable manufacturing, regulatory oversight, data governance, and equitable deployment. Overall, AI-integrated biomedical microdevices represent a promising approach to rapid, decentralised, and actionable AMR diagnostics and surveillance, contingent on robust real-world validation.
zh_abstract: [Biomedical microdevices] 抗微生物药物耐药性（AMR）需要快速可靠的诊断技术，以支持及时的抗微生物药物选择和管理。尽管传统的基于培养的抗微生物药物敏感性试验（AST）在临床上仍然重要，但其较长的周转时间限制了及时干预；而分子诊断可快速识别耐药决定因素，但可能无法准确预测表型耐药。本综述批判性地审视人工智能（AI）与生物医学微器件和生物传感器在快速 AMR 检测中的整合，涵盖微流控和芯片实验室平台、电化学和光学生物传感器以及基于 CRISPR 的技术。重点放在 AI 在信号处理、降噪、模式识别、多重检测以及对复杂生物传感器输出的预测性解释中的应用。对关键转化挑战进行了批判性评估，包括生物污垢、基质干扰、样本制备变异性、气泡形成、蒸发、信号漂移、无效检测率、设备可重复性以及报告和验证标准化不足。还考虑了嵌入式 AI 的要求，包括内存、计算资源、延迟和能效，以用于便携式即时检验部署。区分分析性、临床和操作验证，重点在于使用代表性标本和参考 AST 方法进行前瞻性多中心评估。除临床诊断外，AI 赋能的微器件有望在“同一健康”（One Health）框架下实现跨废水、农业、兽医和环境场景的去中心化 AMR 监测。转化将需要标准化数据集、可泛化且可解释的 AI、可扩展制造、监管监督、数据治理和公平部署。总体而言，AI 整合的生物医学微器件是快速、去中心化且可付诸行动的 AMR 诊断和监测的一种有前景的方法，但取决于稳健的真实世界验证。

title: Wearable Arrhythmia Detection: Moving from your Watch to your Shirt?
zh_title: 可穿戴心律失常检测：从手表到衣物？
summary: 综述总结可穿戴设备筛查与诊断房颤的证据，指出单导联ECG证据最强，AI可增强节律分析与信号处理。

单导联ECG设备证据最强

局限包括运动伪影与半连续监测

abstract: [Current cardiology reports] Digital devices play an increasingly important role in the detection and screening of cardiac arrhythmias. Atrial fibrillation (AF), the most common arrhythmia, is associated with an increased risk of stroke, heart failure, and mortality. This review summarises the current evidence on wearable devices for screening and diagnosing atrial fibrillation. Numerous studies have demonstrated the value of wearables for AF detection and diagnosis. In addition, artificial intelligence enhances automated rhythm analysis and signal processing, supporting the increasing clinical implementation of digital technologies in outpatient care. Single-lead ECG devices provide the strongest evidence for AF detection, with smartwatches representing one of the most extensively investigated wearable technology. Limitations include motion artefacts and predominantly semi-continuous monitoring. Future research should focus on integrating artificial intelligence to improve signal analysis and artefact reduction, and on evaluating the impact of wearable-based strategies on clinically relevant outcomes, including stroke and heart failure.
zh_abstract: [Current cardiology reports] 数字设备在心律失常的检测和筛查中发挥着越来越重要的作用。心房颤动（AF）是最常见的心律失常，与卒中、心力衰竭和死亡风险增加相关。本综述总结了可穿戴设备用于筛查和诊断心房颤动的当前证据。大量研究已证明可穿戴设备在AF检测和诊断中的价值。此外，人工智能增强了自动化节律分析和信号处理，支持数字技术在门诊照护中日益增加的临床实施。单导联ECG设备为AF检测提供了最强证据，其中智能手表是被研究最广泛的可穿戴技术之一。局限性包括运动伪影以及主要为半连续监测。未来研究应聚焦于整合人工智能以改善信号分析和减少伪影，并评估基于可穿戴设备的策略对临床相关结局（包括卒中和心力衰竭）的影响。

title: LTVAE: Hybrid LSTM-Transformer VAE Architecture for Molecular SMILES Representation.
zh_title: LTVAE：LSTM-Transformer混合VAE的分子SMILES表征
summary: 同行评审论文提出混合LSTM-Transformer变分自编码器学习SMILES潜在表征，并报告重构指标。
key_points: 双向LSTM编码、Transformer解码重构SMILES
ZINC15训练，另用染料数据集做分布外评估
报告98.58%词元准确率与99.30%化学有效性
reason: 常规分子表征模型的小幅改进，仅报告重构指标、无下游验证，属增量档。
abstract: [Journal of computational chemistry] A hybrid LSTM-Transformer Variational Autoencoder (LTVAE) framework is introduced in this paper for learning compact and chemically meaningful latent representations from SMILES strings, providing a SMILES-to-latent-to-SMILES representation model trained on ZINC15 and evaluated on ZINC15 and an out-of-distribution dye dataset. In the proposed model, sequential and structural dependencies in molecular strings are encoded using a bidirectional LSTM, while a Transformer-based decoder is employed to reconstruct valid molecular structures in the evaluated settings. When trained on a curated ZINC15 dataset, the framework achieves reasonable reconstruction performance, with 98.58% token-level accuracy, 92.19% string-level accuracy, a 99.30% chemical validity ratio, and an average Levenshtein distance of 0.29 using a 64-dimensional latent space. Reconstruction under an out-of-distribution evaluation setting is evaluated on a structurally distinct dye dataset, where 95.56% token-level accuracy and 85.30% validity are achieved. The learned latent space preserves trends aligned with both general molecular descriptors and dye-relevant structural descriptors, particularly conjugation length and aromatic surface fraction, with Fsp 3 providing complementary information on molecular saturation. Controlled perturbations in the latent space suggest smooth and chemically consistent structural variations, illustrating the continuity and interpretability of the learned latent manifold.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Computational Chemistry] 本文介绍了一种混合 LSTM-Transformer 变分自编码器（LTVAE）框架，用于从 SMILES 字符串中学习紧凑且具有化学意义的潜在表示，提供了一个 SMILES 到潜在表示再到 SMILES 的表示模型，该模型在 ZINC15 上训练，并在 ZINC15 和一个分布外染料数据集上评估。在所提出的模型中，使用双向 LSTM 编码分子字符串中的序列和结构依赖关系，同时采用基于 Transformer 的解码器在评估设置中重建有效的分子结构。在整理后的 ZINC15 数据集上训练时，该框架取得了合理的重建性能：使用 64 维潜在空间时，token 级准确率为 98.58%，字符串级准确率为 92.19%，化学有效性比例为 99.30%，平均 Levenshtein 距离为 0.29。分布外评估设置下的重建在一个结构上不同的染料数据集上进行评估，达到 95.56% 的 token 级准确率和 85.30% 的有效性。学到的潜在空间保留了与一般分子描述符和染料相关结构描述符一致的趋势，尤其是共轭长度和芳香表面分数，其中 Fsp 3 提供关于分子饱和度的补充信息。潜在空间中的受控扰动表明平滑且化学一致的结构变化，说明所学潜在流形的连续性和可解释性。

title: Clinical Photography's Computational Blind Spot.
source: PubMed · The Australasian journal of dermatology
zh_title: 智能手机临床照片的计算盲区
summary: 皮肤科评论指出，手机相机自动合成与降噪处理掩盖原始图像，影响系列监测、研究与AI模型训练，并提出记录与改进建议。
key_points: 手机相机多帧合成与降噪改变纹理
处理过程不可见且厂商格式不透明
建议逐图记录拍摄与处理信息
reason: 述评类文章，无原始数据，仅提出实践建议，属增量档
abstract: [The Australasian journal of dermatology] The smartphone has become dermatology's primary clinical camera, yet the photo it saves is assembled by software rather than being a faithful unedited photograph: several frames are merged, grain is removed, and texture is altered before the image file exists, so no unedited original survives. This processing is hidden, inconsistent between shots, recorded only in undocumented vendor-specific form, and cannot be fully disabled in the camera app. Smartphone photographs still serve to locate a lesion and support a referral, but the processing pipeline is ill-suited and potentially misleading for serial monitoring, research, and training of artificial intelligence models. We propose a per-image record of capture and processing, practical measures clinicians can take now, and smartphone camera processing pipelines built for clinical fidelity rather than aesthetic ends.
zh_abstract: [The Australasian journal of dermatology] 智能手机已成为皮肤科的主要临床相机，但其保存的照片是由软件合成，而非忠实的未经编辑照片：在图像文件生成之前，多帧被合并、噪点被去除、纹理被改变，因此不存在未经编辑的原始图像。这一处理过程是隐蔽的、在不同拍摄之间不一致的、仅以未记录的厂商特定形式记录，并且无法在相机应用中完全禁用。智能手机照片仍可用于定位病变并支持转诊，但其处理流程不适合且可能误导连续监测、研究和人工智能模型训练。我们提出每幅图像的拍摄和处理记录、临床医生现在可采取的实际措施，以及为临床保真度而非美学目的构建的智能手机相机处理流程。

abstract: [Frontiers in immunology] Axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) assessment on MRI is complicated by interpretation difficulty and by clinical variables that may be incomplete at the time of imaging. We aimed to develop an image-only deep learning framework to approximate the clinical assessment of axSpA from sacroiliac joint (SIJ) MRI, integrating fat-suppressed T1-weighted (FS T1) and short tau inversion recovery (STIR) sequences to capture structural and inflammatory information without clinical variables. This retrospective study included patients with chronic back pain who underwent SIJ MRI from January 2010 to December 2021. The treating rheumatologist's clinical diagnosis served as the reference standard. A two-stage framework integrated FS T1 and STIR features with Stage 1-derived binary bone marrow edema (BME) predictions to generate an axSpA probability. Performance in a test set was compared with the Assessment of SpondyloArthritis International Society (ASAS) definition of a "positive MRI" and the ASAS classification criteria using exact McNemar tests; discordant cases were analyzed separately. Among 291 patients (163 axSpA, 128 non-axSpA), the model achieved an AUROC of 0.9412, accuracy of 86.0%, sensitivity of 87.5%, and specificity of 84.0% in the test set (n=57). No significant paired differences in accuracy, sensitivity, or specificity were detected between the model and either ASAS comparator. In an exploratory analysis of 10 cases discordant between ASAS "positive MRI" assessment and clinical diagnosis, the model correctly classified 7 (70.0%). The model showed similar performance to the ASAS-based comparators in the test set without clinical variables, suggesting potential value as an image-based decision-support tool. External multicenter validation is needed to confirm generalizability.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in immunology] 中轴型脊柱关节炎（axSpA）的MRI评估因判读困难以及影像检查时可能不完整的临床变量而变得复杂。我们旨在开发一个仅基于图像的深度学习框架，从骶髂关节（SIJ）MRI近似axSpA的临床评估，整合脂肪抑制T1加权（FS T1）和短tau反转恢复（STIR）序列，以在不使用临床变量的情况下捕获结构和炎症信息。这项回顾性研究纳入2010年1月至2021年12月接受SIJ MRI的慢性背痛患者。主治风湿病学家的临床诊断作为参考标准。一个两阶段框架将FS T1和STIR特征与第1阶段得出的二分类骨髓水肿（BME）预测相结合，以生成axSpA概率。在测试集中，使用精确McNemar检验将模型性能与国际脊柱关节炎评估协会（ASAS）的“阳性MRI”定义及ASAS分类标准进行比较；不一致病例单独分析。在291例患者（163例axSpA，128例非axSpA）中，模型在测试集（n=57）中达到AUROC 0.9412、准确率86.0%、敏感性87.5%、特异性84.0%。模型与任一ASAS比较项之间，在准确率、敏感性或特异性上均未检测到显著配对差异。在对ASAS“阳性MRI”评估与临床诊断不一致的10例病例进行的探索性分析中，模型正确分类7例（70.0%）。该模型在不使用临床变量的测试集中表现出与基于ASAS的比较项相似的性能，提示其作为基于图像的决策支持工具的潜在价值。需要外部多中心验证以确认泛化性。

abstract: Large-scale pharmacogenomic screens provide rich drug-sensitivity measurements in cancer cell lines, but transferring these measurements to patient tumours remains limited by biological heterogeneity and cross-domain distribution shift. Existing machine learning approaches, including adversarial autoencoder and domain adaptation, address this gap by learning shared latent representations between preclinical models and patient samples. However, alignment without explicit biological constraints can produce unreliable representations when cancer lineage structure and clinically relevant patient heterogeneity are not preserved. Biological validation across four curated drug-gene resources identified significant expression differences exceeding 1.5-fold for 34.9-64.4% of drugs in pan-cancer analyses, based on the lowest-p-value annotated gene per drug. As an additional validation, we derived pretreatment responder-nonresponder gene-expression signatures from 13 external breast cancer datasets and evaluated their concordance with MODAE+ predictions across 69 signature-drug comparisons in TCGA patients treated with paclitaxel or doxorubicin. title: Language-guided domain adaptation improves protein sequence rep-resentations for antimicrobial resistance analysis
zh_title: 语言引导域适应改进耐药性蛋白序列表征
summary: bioRxiv预印本提出BacLLM，将注释先验注入蛋白语言模型表征，用于病原菌耐药基因识别与机制预测。
key_points: 融合UniProt注释语义与跨模态对比学习
面向WHO重点病原菌的耐药分析
