abstract: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR), particularly antibiotic resistance in bacterial pathogens, complicates infectious disease management. Because bacterial resistance is often mediated by protein functions, including antibiotic inactivation and efflux, protein sequence analysis provides a molecular basis for digital AMR surveillance and therapeutic intervention. We developed BacLLM, a language guided protein representation framework that integrates annotation-derived functional knowledge into protein language model representations for AMR analysis in WHO priority bacterial pathogens. Through sequence enhancement, semantic enrichment of UniProt annotations, and cross modal contrastive learning, BacLLM transfers LLM encoded annotation priors into the sequence encoder. Compared with baselines, BacLLM provided more informative representations for resistance-gene identification and mechanism prediction, captured resistance associated mutational signals at single-residue resolution, and preserved taxonomic relationships not reflected by phenotype based clinical groupings. Moreover, BacLLM recovered resistance associated functional organization within a TolC-centered protein association network, prioritizing proteins with low sequence identity to TolC but predicted structural similarity to TolC. Extending from AMR characterization to therapeutic prioritization, BacLLM also improved strain-level phage host matching for phage therapy candidate prioritization. Together, these findings establish BacLLM as a protein representation framework supporting AMR surveillance, functional characterization, and therapeutic candidate prioritization.
zh_abstract: 抗菌药物耐药性（AMR），尤其是细菌病原体中的抗生素耐药性，使感染性疾病管理复杂化。由于细菌耐药性通常由蛋白质功能介导，包括抗生素灭活和外排，蛋白质序列分析为数字化AMR监测和治疗干预提供了分子基础。我们开发了BacLLM，这是一种语言引导的蛋白质表示框架，它将来自注释的功能知识整合到蛋白质语言模型表示中，用于WHO优先细菌病原体的AMR分析。通过序列增强、UniProt注释的语义富集和跨模态对比学习，BacLLM将LLM编码的注释先验转移到序列编码器中。与基线相比，BacLLM为耐药基因识别和机制预测提供了更具信息量的表示，在单残基分辨率上捕获了耐药相关突变信号，并保留了基于表型的临床分组未反映的分类学关系。此外，BacLLM在以TolC为中心的蛋白质关联网络中恢复了耐药相关功能组织，优先考虑与TolC序列同一性低但预测与TolC结构相似的蛋白质。从AMR表征扩展到治疗优先级排序，BacLLM还改善了菌株水平的噬菌体宿主匹配，用于噬菌体治疗候选物优先级排序。总之，这些发现确立了BacLLM作为一个支持AMR监测、功能表征和治疗候选物优先级排序的蛋白质表示框架。

abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for clinical deployment of cancer diagnosis models, yet neural networks and variational Gaussian process methods can produce overconfident predictions, particularly under the distribution shifts that arise when models trained at one hospital are applied at another. We present a scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification (GPC) framework that operates on frozen pathology foundation model embeddings (Phikon) and combines accelerated Randomly Pivoted Cholesky (RPCholesky) for low-rank kernel factorization, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) with non-centered parameterization for posterior sampling, and a pivots-as-inducing-points scheme for prediction. This makes HMC posterior sampling in the low-rank latent representation tractable at N approximately 300,000 training points, enabling HC-based low-rank GPC on substantially larger datasets than prior MCMC-based demonstrations. We evaluate on two histopathology benchmarks for breast cancer metastasis detection: PCam and CAMELYON17-WILDS, where the latter tests calibration under hospital-level distribution shift. Compared to stochastic variational GP and neural network baselines, our method improves calibration and predictive performance - reducing expected calibration error by up to 88% and false negative rate by up to 90% - with the largest gains appearing under distribution shift, suggesting that HMC-based posterior sampling provides more trustworthy uncertainty estimates for cross-site pathology classification.
zh_abstract: 可靠的不确定性量化对于癌症诊断模型的临床部署至关重要，但神经网络和变分高斯过程方法可能产生过度自信的预测，尤其是在模型在一家医院训练后应用于另一家医院时出现的分布偏移下。我们提出了一种可扩展的贝叶斯高斯过程分类（GPC）框架，该框架作用于冻结的病理基础模型嵌入（Phikon），并结合了用于低秩核分解的加速随机枢轴 Cholesky（Randomly Pivoted Cholesky, RPCholesky）、采用非中心参数化的哈密顿蒙特卡洛（HMC）后验采样，以及用于预测的枢轴作为诱导点方案。这使得在低秩潜在表示中进行 HMC 后验采样在约 300,000 个训练点（N 约 300,000）时变得可行，从而使基于 HC 的低秩 GPC 能够应用于比先前基于 MCMC 的演示大得多的数据集。我们在两个用于乳腺癌转移检测的组织病理学基准上进行了评估：PCam 和 CAMELYON17-WILDS，其中后者测试医院层面分布偏移下的校准。与随机变分 GP 和神经网络基线相比，我们的方法改善了校准和预测性能——将期望校准误差最多降低 88%，将假阴性率最多降低 90%——最大增益出现在分布偏移下，这表明基于 HMC 的后验采样为跨站点病理分类提供了更可信的不确定性估计。

title: Classifying tumors from broad category to hierarchical molecular subtype: an interpretable hierarchical framework for precision oncology
zh_title: 从大类到分子亚型的可解释层级肿瘤分类框架
summary: bioRxiv预印本提出基于癌症标志物的层级递归模型HHRM，在11476例泛癌样本上做多层级亚型分类。
key_points: 将层级标签结构与递归神经网络结合

强调细粒度泛癌分类中的可解释性
reason: 样本量较大、方法有层级创新，但为预印本且验证信息有限
abstract: Precise tumor subtype classification is important for guiding personalized treatment, characterizing tumor heterogeneity, and investigating molecular mechanisms. However, most existing multi-label classification models use flat architectures and do not fully exploit the inherent hierarchical relationships and biological constraints among tumor types, which limits their performance and interpretability in complex, fine-grained pan-cancer classification. Here, we present the cancer Hallmark-based Hierarchical Recursive Model (HHRM) for pan-cancer hierarchical multi-label classification. HHRM integrates hierarchical label structures with recursive neural networks, enabling simultaneous modeling of multi-level dependencies from broad cancer categories to specific subtypes. We trained the model on a comprehensive pan-cancer cohort of 11,476 samples spanning 26 primary cancer types and 405 subtypes across up to eight hierarchical levels. HHRM achieved an accuracy of 0.7924 for predicting hierarchical tumor subtypes and was further evaluated on a validation dataset of 887 samples. Compared with other hierarchical modeling frameworks, HHRM achieved higher accuracy in all three output modes. Ablation experiments showed that replacing the hallmark-based graph convolutional network reduced model performance. On an independent dataset of 1,608 breast cancer samples, HHRM also achieved an accuracy greater than 0.86. Finally, we combined SHAP with a network-based method to rank and analyze predictive genes at different levels of the tumor hierarchy, which identified both known and potentially novel biomarkers for cancer diagnosis. In conclusion, to our knowledge, HHRM is the first hierarchical model for multi-level tumor subtype classification. Its competitive performance, combined with post hoc biological interpretation, suggests potential value for precision cancer diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 精确的肿瘤亚型分类对于指导个性化治疗、表征肿瘤异质性以及研究分子机制非常重要。然而，大多数现有的多标签分类模型使用扁平架构，未充分利用肿瘤类型之间固有的层次关系和生物学约束，这限制了它们在复杂、细粒度的泛癌分类中的性能和可解释性。在此，我们提出了基于癌症 Hallmark 的层次递归模型（HHRM），用于泛癌层次多标签分类。HHRM 将层次标签结构与递归神经网络相结合，能够同时建模从广泛癌症类别到特定亚型的多级依赖关系。我们在一个包含 11,476 个样本的综合泛癌队列上训练了该模型，该队列涵盖 26 种原发癌症类型和 405 种亚型，横跨多达八个层次级别。HHRM 在预测层次肿瘤亚型方面达到了 0.7924 的准确率，并在一个包含 887 个样本的验证数据集上进一步评估。与其他层次建模框架相比，HHRM 在全部三种输出模式下均取得了更高的准确率。消融实验表明，替换基于 Hallmark 的图卷积网络会降低模型性能。在一个包含 1,608 个乳腺癌样本的独立数据集上，HHRM 也达到了大于 0.86 的准确率。最后，我们将 SHAP 与一种基于网络的方法相结合，对肿瘤层次不同级别的预测基因进行排序和分析，识别出了已知的和可能的新癌症诊断生物标志物。总之，据我们所知，HHRM 是首个用于多级肿瘤亚型分类的层次模型。其具有竞争力的性能，结合事后生物学解释，提示其可能对精准癌症诊断具有价值。

title: First-trimester nocturnal cardiorespiratory coupling during home sleep testing and later pregnancy complications: a secondary analysis of the nuMoM2b cohort
zh_title: 孕早期夜间心肺耦合与后续妊娠并发症关联
summary: 基于nuMoM2b队列2504名初产妇，分析孕早期家庭睡眠监测心肺耦合与后续妊娠并发症的关联。
key_points: 2504名初产妇家庭睡眠记录

reason: 大型队列二次分析但为预印本、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: We tested whether direction-specific nocturnal cardiorespiratory coupling (CRC) in the first trimester differed in pregnancies that later developed obstetric complications. The analysis included 2504 nulliparous women from the nuMoM2b cohort with valid level 3 home sleep recordings at 6-13 weeks' gestation. Bidirectional CRC between RR intervals and abdominal respiratory effort was quantified using bivariate phase-rectified signal averaging in consecutive 5-min segments. Coupling strength, local transition dynamics, and waveform irregularity were summarized by nightly mean and standard deviation. Associations with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM; n = 111), preeclampsia (n = 149), preterm birth (n = 192), and fetal macrosomia (n = 186) were examined using proportional-odds models with CRC feature quintile as the ordered outcome. Models included all four complications simultaneously and adjusted for maternal age, pre-pregnancy body mass index, race and ethnicity, gestational age at recording, relevant medical and family history, medication use, and apnea-hypopnea index >5 events/h. Holm correction was applied across outcomes. GDM was associated with lower respiration-to-heart rate coupling strength (cumulative odds ratio, 0.45; 95% CI, 0.31-0.64; P < 0.001) and shallower slope at the anchor point (0.63; 0.45-0.89; P = 0.03). Fetal macrosomia was associated with lower within-night variability in heart rate-to-respiration waveform irregularity (0.59; 0.45-0.77; P < 0.001). No associations with preeclampsia or preterm birth remained significant after correction. Direction-specific differences in nocturnal CRC were detectable in the first trimester in pregnancies that later developed GDM or resulted in fetal macrosomia.
zh_abstract: 我们检验了在后来发生产科并发症的妊娠中，妊娠早期方向特异性的夜间心肺耦合（cardiorespiratory coupling, CRC）是否存在差异。分析纳入nuMoM2b队列中2504名在妊娠6-13周具有有效3级家庭睡眠记录的无产史女性。使用双变量相位整流信号平均法在连续5分钟片段中量化RR间期与腹部呼吸努力之间的双向CRC。耦合强度、局部转换动力学和波形不规则性以每夜均值和标准差进行汇总。使用比例优势模型检查与妊娠期糖尿病（GDM；n = 111）、子痫前期（n = 149）、早产（n = 192）和胎儿巨大儿（n = 186）的关联，以CRC特征五分位数作为有序结局。模型同时纳入全部四种并发症，并校正母亲年龄、孕前体重指数、种族和族裔、记录时孕龄、相关病史和家族史、用药以及呼吸暂停低通气指数 >5次/小时。对各结局应用Holm校正。GDM与较低的呼吸到心率耦合强度相关（累积比值比，0.45；95% CI，0.31-0.64；P < 0.001），并与锚点处较浅的斜率相关（0.63；0.45-0.89；P = 0.03）。胎儿巨大儿与心率到呼吸波形不规则性的夜间内变异性较低相关（0.59；0.45-0.77；P < 0.001）。校正后，与子痫前期或早产的关联均不再显著。在后来发生GDM或导致胎儿巨大儿的妊娠中，妊娠早期即可检测到夜间CRC的方向特异性差异。

title: FeatureMAP enables network-guided interpretation of untargeted metabolomics
zh_title: FeatureMAP：网络引导的非靶向代谢组学解读框架
summary: 预印本提出整合多证据注释、网络细化与 LLM 功能解读的 LC-MS 代谢组学框架。
key_points: 在十个公开数据集上改善候选代谢物优先级
半合成基准中恢复92%的模拟扰动
引入结构化大模型进行功能解读
reason: 预印本新框架，多数据集与基准对比但证据限于计算验证
abstract: Untargeted liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) metabolomics generates thousands of features, but incomplete metabolite annotation and reliance on predefined pathways limit their biological interpretation. Here we present FeatureMAP, an LC-MS feature-centric computational framework that integrates multi-evidence metabolite annotation, network-guided refinement, metabolic module discovery, and structured large language model-based functional interpretation. Across ten public datasets, FeatureMAP improved MS1-based metabolite candidate prioritization while reducing annotation redundancy. In semi-synthetic benchmarks, FeatureMAP recovered coordinated metabolic perturbations, achieving 92% recovery of a simulated perturbation, and distinguished concurrent metabolic processes. Controlled benchmarks further evaluated functional interpretation under competing metabolite-level signals. Based on FeatureMAP, we additionally developed PhenoMAP, a phenotype-aware knowledge graph comprising 12,929 dysregulated metabolic modules from 501 human metabolomics studies spanning 326 phenotypes. Module-level comparisons revealed reproducible metabolic similarities across independent studies and biologically supported relationships among phenotypes. Application to Alzheimer's disease cerebrospinal fluid and cellular datasets identified convergent membrane-lipid alterations and implicated galactose-linked glycosphingolipid remodeling. Together, FeatureMAP and PhenoMAP enable network-grounded interpretation of incompletely annotated LC-MS metabolomics data and systematic investigation of metabolic dysregulation across biological conditions.
zh_abstract: 非靶向液相色谱-质谱（LC-MS）代谢组学可产生数千个特征，但不完整的代谢物注释和对预定义通路的依赖限制了其生物学解释。在此，我们提出 FeatureMAP，这是一种以 LC-MS 特征为中心的计算框架，整合了多证据代谢物注释、网络引导的细化、代谢模块发现以及基于结构化大语言模型的功能解释。在十个公共数据集中，FeatureMAP 改善了基于 MS1 的代谢物候选排序，同时减少了注释冗余。在半合成基准测试中，FeatureMAP 恢复了协同代谢扰动，对模拟扰动达到 92% 的恢复率，并区分了同时发生的代谢过程。受控基准测试进一步评估了在相互竞争的代谢物水平信号下的功能解释。基于 FeatureMAP，我们还开发了 PhenoMAP，这是一个表型感知知识图谱，包含来自 501 项人类代谢组学研究、涵盖 326 种表型的 12,929 个失调代谢模块。模块水平比较揭示了独立研究之间可重复的代谢相似性以及表型之间具有生物学支持的关系。应用于阿尔茨海默病脑脊液和细胞数据集时，识别出趋同的膜脂改变，并提示半乳糖连接的鞘糖脂重塑。总之，FeatureMAP 和 PhenoMAP 使得对注释不完整的 LC-MS 代谢组学数据进行基于网络的解释，并系统研究不同生物学条件下的代谢失调成为可能。

title: CardioLM: A multilingual suite of small language models for the cardiology domain
zh_title: CardioLM：心脏病领域多语言小模型套件
summary: 预印本发布心脏病多语言语料CardioCCC（508份病例报告、7种语言）及CardioBERTa编码器与CardioNER识别模型。
key_points: CardioCCC含508份心脏病病例报告，覆盖7种语言
经机器翻译、标注投影与临床医生审核构建
发布CardioBERTa编码器与CardioNER命名实体识别模型
reason: 多语言心脏病语料与模型开源，规模中等、预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Cardiovascular care generates large volumes of clinical free-text documentation in local languages. However, clinical natural language processing (NLP) resources remain concentrated in English, and no existing benchmark is cardiology-specific, multilingual, and broad in entity coverage. Methods: We present two contributions. The first is CardioCCC, a corpus of 508 cardiology case reports originally published in Spanish and extended to Czech, Dutch, English, Italian, Romanian, and Swedish through machine translation, annotation projection, and clinician review, with annotations covering diseases, symptoms, procedures, and medications. The second is CardioLM, comprising CardioBERTa, a set of language-specific encoders obtained by continued pretraining on cardiology and biomedical corpora, and CardioNER, a set of named entity recognition (NER) models fine-tuned on CardioCCC. Results: Cardiology-specific pretraining reduced pseudo-perplexity by up to a factor of eight, yet changed strict span-level F1 by at most 0.04, with benefits concentrated in languages whose backbones lacked biomedical coverage. The jointly trained multilingual XLM-RoBERTa-large models achieved the best strict F1 in nearly every language and entity type, exceeding the strongest monolingual system by up to 0.13 F1. A large share of residual errors concerned boundary detection: relaxed matching recovered 0.10-0.23 F1 for disease, procedure, and symptom, but only 0.01-0.07 for medication. Clinicians rated CardioNER well above a rule- and dictionary-based baseline, with the mean rating across entity types rising from 26% to 73%. Conclusions: Specialty-specific pretraining is not the decisive factor for downstream entity recognition, whereas multilingual joint training yields the strongest results in nearly all settings and a simpler deployment path for multi-country clinical information extraction.
zh_abstract: 【背景】心血管诊疗会产生大量本地语言的临床自由文本记录。然而，临床自然语言处理（NLP）资源仍集中在英语，且尚无现有基准同时具备心脏病学特异性、多语言性和广泛的实体覆盖。【方法】我们提出两项贡献。第一是 CardioCCC，一个包含508篇心脏病学病例报告的语料库，最初以西班牙语发表，并通过机器翻译、标注投影和临床医生审核扩展到捷克语、荷兰语、英语、意大利语、罗马尼亚语和瑞典语，标注覆盖疾病、症状、操作和药物。第二是 CardioLM，包括 CardioBERTa，即通过在心脏病学和生物医学语料上继续预训练获得的一组语言特定编码器，以及 CardioNER，即一组在 CardioCCC 上微调的命名实体识别（NER）模型。【结果】心脏病学特异性预训练使伪困惑度最多降至原来的八分之一，但严格跨度级 F1 的变化至多为 0.04，且收益集中在骨干模型缺乏生物医学覆盖的语言中。联合训练的多语言 XLM-RoBERTa-large 模型在几乎所有语言和实体类型中取得了最佳严格 F1，超过最强的单语言系统最多 0.13 F1。相当一部分残余错误涉及边界检测：宽松匹配为疾病、操作和症状恢复了 0.10-0.23 F1，但对药物仅恢复 0.01-0.07。临床医生对 CardioNER 的评分远高于基于规则和词典的基线，跨实体类型的平均评分从 26% 上升到 73%。【结论】专科特异性预训练并非下游实体识别的决定性因素，而多语言联合训练在几乎所有设置中产生最强结果，并为多国临床信息抽取提供更简单的部署路径。

title: Agent-Driven Generative Priors for Pathology Image Synthesis and Segmentation
zh_title: 智能体驱动的生成先验用于病理图像合成与分割

key_points: 病理智能体做质量评估与样本筛选
构建TCGA-200K共217030张病理切片
生成模型骨干学习结构语义表征
表征迁移用于下游分割任务
reason: 有新方法且构建较大数据集，但为预印本、外部验证与开源情况不明
abstract: Deep learning methods for pathology are constrained by the limited availability and high cost of large-scale pixel-level annotations. Synthetic data can alleviate this limitation, but existing pipelines often lack reliable quality control and remain weakly connected to downstream analysis. To address these issues, we propose a three-stage framework that integrates automated data screening, generative representation learning, and efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. First, we develop a pathology agent system to assess image quality and filter samples, resulting in TCGA-200K, a dataset containing 217,030 pathology patches selected from the public TCGA repository. Second, we train a generative model on the screened data. In addition to image synthesis, its backbone learns structural and semantic representations that can be transferred to downstream tasks. Third, we adapt the pretrained generative backbone to semantic segmentation using a lightweight task-specific head. We further introduce PathSeg-380K, a semantic segmentation dataset with expert annotations for approximately 380,000 cells across 12 cell types. Experiments on multiple pathology datasets show that the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath.
zh_abstract: 病理学的深度学习方法受到大规模像素级标注的可用性有限和高成本的制约。合成数据可以缓解这一限制，但现有流程往往缺乏可靠的质量控制，并且与下游分析的联系仍然较弱。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一个三阶段框架，整合自动数据筛选、生成式表示学习以及对下游任务的高效适应。首先，我们开发了一个病理智能体系统来评估图像质量并过滤样本，从而产生了 TCGA-200K，这是一个包含从公共 TCGA 存储库中选出的 217,030 个病理图像块的数据集。其次，我们在筛选后的数据上训练生成模型。除了图像合成外，其主干网络还学习可迁移到下游任务的结构和语义表示。第三，我们使用轻量级任务特定头将预训练的生成主干网络适配到语义分割。我们进一步引入了 PathSeg-380K，这是一个语义分割数据集，包含跨 12 种细胞类型的约 380,000 个细胞的专家标注。在多个病理数据集上的实验表明，所提出的框架达到了最先进的分割性能。我们的代码公开可用，地址为 https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath。

title: Computation, not weight access: large language models as auditors of clinical prediction networks
zh_title: 计算而非权重：大模型作为临床预测网络审计者
summary: 预印本在预设仿真实验中区分“读原始权重”与“运行代码”，考察大模型能否仅凭计算工具审计临床预测网络。
key_points: 对105至38401权重的小网络做仿真实验
数据模拟蛛网膜下腔出血患者队列
设定白盒与黑盒两种工具条件
指出既往演示混淆了读权重与运行代码
reason: 方法学问题清晰、实验设计规范，但为仿真预印本，临床外推有限
abstract: Frontier large language models (LLMs) have been reported to read, edit and write the weights of small neural networks, raising the prospect of auditing clinical prediction models from their files alone. Public demonstrations, however, mixed reading raw weights with running code. We separated these conditions in internally pre-specified simulation experiments. Tanh networks of 105 to 38,401 weights were trained on simulated cohorts of patients with subarachnoid haemorrhage, each with a planted relationship or none, and one network was trained on labels that under-recorded deaths in a subgroup. GPT-6 Astra and four other GPT models answered single prompts under a default or an explicit system instruction, either with the weights in the prompt and no tools, or with a calculation-only tool that exposed the weights (white box) or only the network's predictions (black box). Without tools, Astra recovered planted relationships in 353-weight networks but became unreliable at 3,457 weights, and under the default instruction it declined 11 of 12 audit and repair tasks as unidentifiable; the explicit instruction removed these refusals. With the tool, it recovered the planted relationship in all 29 runs on networks of up to 38,401 weights, raised no false alarm in 15 runs on null networks, and found the biased subgroup in 6 of 6 runs. Black-box access performed as well as white-box access, and other GPT-6 models read as accurately. A well-designed script matched the comparator models on the audit and the best LLM repair. For auditing these networks, what mattered was computation and elicitation, not access to the weights.
zh_abstract: 据报道，前沿大语言模型（LLM）能够读取、编辑和写入小型神经网络的权重，这提出了仅凭文件审计临床预测模型的前景。然而，公开演示将读取原始权重与运行代码混在一起。我们在内部预先设定的模拟实验中分离了这些条件。105至38,401个权重的Tanh网络在模拟的蛛网膜下腔出血患者队列上训练，每个队列植入一种关系或不植入关系，其中一个网络在低估某亚组死亡记录的标签上训练。GPT-6 Astra和其他四个GPT模型在默认或明确的系统指令下回答单个提示，要么权重在提示中且无工具，要么使用仅计算工具，该工具暴露权重（白盒）或仅暴露网络预测（黑盒）。无工具时，Astra在353个权重的网络中恢复了植入关系，但在3,457个权重时变得不可靠；在默认指令下，它以无法识别为由拒绝了12项审计和修复任务中的11项；明确指令消除了这些拒绝。使用该工具时，它在所有29次运行中均于最多38,401个权重的网络上恢复了植入关系，在15次零网络运行中未发出假警报，并在6/6次运行中发现了有偏亚组。黑盒访问与白盒访问表现一样好，其他GPT-6模型读取同样准确。一个设计良好的脚本在审计方面与对照模型相当，并与最佳LLM修复相当。对于审计这些网络，重要的是计算和引出（elicitation），而不是对权重的访问。

title: When Verification Is Not Agreement: Cross-Agent LLM-to-Dafny Formalization
zh_title: 跨智能体LLM-Dafny临床试验标准形式化
summary: 提出跨智能体形式化协议，将临床试验标准转为Dafny谓词并校验，96份文件上一致率随角色分配差异大。
key_points: 同模型重复抽取一致率仅59.3%
强模型作实现者时一致率53.0%，反转仅14.3%
在96份临床试验文件上评测四种模型配置
reason: 预印本新方法，有基线对照但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: A verified Dafny postcondition certifies that a formula holds, but it does not guarantee that the result was reached through genuine independent reasoning. We introduce a cross-agent formalization protocol where a Specifier model translates clinical trial criteria into a Dafny predicate, and an Implementer model writes an operational method checked against it. A same-model control establishes that even with no capability gap, independent re-extraction from identical text agrees only 59.3% of the time. Evaluating four model configurations on 96 clinical trial documents, we find that agreement is highly sensitive to how model capability is allocated across the two roles: the GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4.1-mini configuration achieves 53.0% agreement when the stronger model is the Implementer, but only 14.3% when the roles are reversed. The strongest tested configuration, GPT-5.6-luna/GPT-5.4-mini, improves agreement to 34.4% but remains below the same-model baseline and is dominated by direct contradiction (42.7%). We also detect a critical verification artifact in which a weaker Implementer satisfies the postcondition by invoking the Specifier's predicate directly; after structural auditing, corrected agreement falls from 14.3% to 13.2%. Our results show that verification success alone is insufficient evidence of independent cross-agent agreement, and that model capability does not guarantee agreement when formalizing the same source independently.
zh_abstract: 一个经过验证的Dafny后置条件证明某个公式成立，但并不保证该结果是通过真正的独立推理得出的。我们引入一种跨智能体形式化协议，其中Specifier模型将临床试验标准转换为Dafny谓词，Implementer模型编写一个操作方法并依据该谓词进行检查。同模型对照表明，即使不存在能力差距，从相同文本独立重新抽取也仅在59.3%的情况下一致。在96份临床试验文件上评估四种模型配置，我们发现一致率对模型能力在两个角色间的分配高度敏感：GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4.1-mini配置在较强模型为Implementer时达到53.0%的一致率，但角色反转时仅为14.3%。最强测试配置GPT-5.6-luna/GPT-5.4-mini将一致率提高到34.4%，但仍低于同模型基线，且以直接矛盾为主（42.7%）。我们还发现一个关键的验证伪影：较弱的Implementer通过直接调用Specifier的谓词来满足后置条件；经结构审计后，校正一致率从14.3%降至13.2%。我们的结果表明，仅验证成功不足以证明跨智能体独立一致，而且模型能力并不能保证在独立形式化同一来源时达成一致。

title: OcTreeMamba: Topology-Aware Mamba for 3D Medical Segmentation via Octree Sparsification
zh_title: OcTreeMamba：基于八叉树稀疏化的拓扑感知3D医学分割
summary: 预印本提出将八叉树结构引入状态空间模型的层级框架，实现3D解剖结构的拓扑感知长程上下文传播。
key_points: 用结构学习器做解剖自适应稀疏化，通过层级门控与Gumbel-Softmax实现可微区域选择
针对启发式选择性扫描破坏空间层级、计算冗余的问题
面向3D医学图像分割任务，摘要未报告具体数据集与外部验证
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，但摘要未体现对照实验与外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Accurate segmentation of 3D anatomical structures is crucial to medical image analysis. Recently, Mamba-based approaches have achieved promising segmentation performance in capturing long-range dependencies with linear-time computational complexity. However, heuristic selective scanning strategies inherently disrupt the intrinsic spatial hierarchy and increase computational redundancy, ignoring the inherent sparsity of 3D anatomical structures. To this end, we propose OcTreeMamba, a hierarchical framework that incorporates Octree structures into SSM, achieving 3D topology-aware long-range context feature propagation and integration. Specifically, a Structure Learner performs anatomy-adaptive structured sparsification through hierarchical gating and Gumbel-Softmax sampling, enabling differentiable selection of anatomical regions. The selected regions are subsequently organized by a Dynamic Octree Builder into a multi-level topology that preserves their hierarchical connectivity. Based on the constructed Octree, a bidirectional Tree-SSM propagates and integrates contextual features along connectivity-aware leaf--parent--root and root--parent--leaf trajectories. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets show that our proposed OcTreeMamba achieves competitive performance \wrt topological continuity and computational efficiency, particularly for recovering the complex structure on vascular datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/MikeMak123/OcTreeMamba.
zh_abstract: 3D 解剖结构的准确分割对医学图像分析至关重要。近期，基于 Mamba 的方法在以线性时间计算复杂度捕捉长程依赖方面取得了有前景的分割性能。然而，启发式选择性扫描策略本质上会破坏内在空间层次结构并增加计算冗余，同时忽略 3D 解剖结构固有的稀疏性。为此，我们提出 OcTreeMamba，一个将 Octree 结构纳入 SSM 的分层框架，实现 3D 拓扑感知的远程上下文特征传播与集成。具体而言，结构学习器（Structure Learner）通过分层门控和 Gumbel-Softmax 采样执行解剖自适应结构化稀疏化，从而实现解剖区域的可微选择。随后，动态 Octree 构建器（Dynamic Octree Builder）将所选区域组织为多级拓扑，保留其层次连通性。基于所构建的 Octree，双向 Tree-SSM 沿连接性感知的叶--父--根和根--父--叶轨迹传播并整合上下文特征。在四个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们提出的 OcTreeMamba 在拓扑连续性和计算效率方面取得了有竞争力的性能，尤其是在恢复血管数据集上的复杂结构方面。代码可在 https://github.com/MikeMak123/OcTreeMamba 获取。

title: TRiST: Topology-Reinforced Swin Transformer for Medical Image Analysis
zh_title: TRiST：拓扑强化的Swin Transformer医学图像分析
summary: 预印本提出在Swin各阶段显式嵌入持续同调拓扑信息的框架，用于医学图像分析。
key_points: 在四个Swin原生阶段分别计算2D持续同调H0/H1，避免细尺度拓扑被下采样
用带状感知的H0/H1残差细化模块分别处理短、中、长持久性信息
将拓扑信息融入特征构建、细化与注意力；摘要未给出验证规模
reason: 方法有新意但证据限于预印本摘要，未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical images contain topological patterns, such as connected components and loops, at scales ranging from small lesions to organ boundaries. Although hierarchical Vision Transformers have advanced medical image analysis, they do not explicitly incorporate topology throughout their multiscale representations. We propose Topology-Reinforced Swin Transformer (TRiST), a framework that integrates topological information into feature construction, refinement, and attention. First, a Hierarchical Multi-Scale Topology Representation algorithm computes 2D persistent homology (H0 and H1) independently at four native Swin stages, producing descriptors aligned with each stage's token grid rather than downsampling fine-scale topology. Second, a Band-Aware H0/H1 Residual Refinement module uses gated residual networks to process short-, medium-, and long-persistence information separately. Third, a Persistence-Band Progressive Attention Bias converts stage-specific descriptors into learned key-saliency scores that directly modify shifted-window attention logits. We instantiate TRiST as Topo-SwinV2-B for classification and Topo-Swin-UNet for segmentation, preserving the underlying Swin-based backbones. Experiments on five medical image datasets show consistent improvements over Swin-based baselines and competitive performance relative to existing topology-augmented methods.
zh_abstract: 医学图像包含拓扑模式，例如连通分量和环路，其尺度从小病变到器官边界不等。尽管分层视觉 Transformer（Vision Transformer）推动了医学图像分析的发展，但它们并未在其多尺度表示中明确纳入拓扑。我们提出拓扑强化 Swin Transformer（Topology-Reinforced Swin Transformer，TRiST），一个将拓扑信息整合到特征构建、细化和注意力中的框架。首先，分层多尺度拓扑表示算法在四个原生 Swin 阶段独立计算 2D 持久同调（persistent homology）（H0 和 H1），生成与每个阶段 token 网格对齐的描述符，而不是对细尺度拓扑进行下采样。其次，带状感知 H0/H1 残差细化模块使用门控残差网络分别处理短、中、长持久性信息。第三，持久性带状渐进注意力偏置将阶段特定描述符转换为学习到的键显著性分数，直接修改移位窗口注意力 logits。我们将 TRiST 实例化为用于分类的 Topo-SwinV2-B 和用于分割的 Topo-Swin-UNet，同时保留底层基于 Swin 的主干网络。在五个医学图像数据集上的实验表明，相比基于 Swin 的基线取得一致改进，并相对于现有拓扑增强方法具有有竞争力的性能。

title: Trick-or-Treat: Adversarial Evaluation of Multimodal Medical Reasoning with Synthetic Images
zh_title: Trick-or-Treat：合成图像对抗式多模态医学推理评测
summary: 预印本构建对抗式多模态基准，将真实胸片与合成临床照片配对，用于暴露前沿模型的跨模态幻觉行为。
key_points: 真实胸片搭配合成体表照片构成配对
匹配与不匹配对用于检验跨模态一致性
覆盖多种疾病条件
目标是暴露前沿模型的幻觉行为
reason: 新评测基准构思有新意，但为预印本且尚无模型评测结论细节
abstract: We used medical image synthesis to create a challenging multimodal evaluation framework that exposes hallucination behaviors in frontier models. Evaluating multimodal reasoning has historically been difficult because existing medical datasets rarely pair different image modalities, such as radiographs and external clinical photographs. To address this gap, we introduce Trick-or-Treat, an adversarial multimodal medical benchmark that pairs real chest radiographs with synthetic clinical photographs to challenge models' cross-modal reasoning. For each of a wide range of conditions, we created two pairs of images, where the pairs share a single chest radiograph but contain different external photographs. In matched pairs, the chest radiograph and photograph both contain findings suggesting the same disease (e.g., varicella pneumonia suggested by lung opacities and crusted skin lesions seen in chickenpox). In mismatched pairs, the photograph depicts an alternative clinical finding that would not lead to the same unifying diagnosis (e.g. replacing crusted skin lesions with ordinary acne). Synthetic photograph generation allows clinical findings to be varied while the person's features and photographic setting stay consistent, reducing confounding. In an investigation of three frontier models, we found that models hallucinated clinically significant photograph findings in 45-57.5% of mismatched pairs, up from 25-37.5% for the same photographs shown alone. When faced with mismatched pairs, models tended to ignore mismatches and instead hallucinated findings that better matched the radiograph (e.g. misreading acne as crusted skin lesions to justify diagnosing chickenpox). Trick-or-Treat both demonstrates concerning error pattern in frontier models' medical reasoning and provides a proof of concept for the use of synthetic images in adversarial multimodal evaluation.
zh_abstract: 我们使用医学图像合成构建了一个具有挑战性的多模态评估框架，用以揭示前沿模型中的幻觉行为。评估多模态推理历来困难，因为现有医学数据集很少将不同图像模态配对，例如X线片与外部临床照片。为弥补这一空白，我们引入了Trick-or-Treat，一个对抗性多模态医学基准，将真实胸部X线片与合成的临床照片配对，以挑战模型的跨模态推理。对于多种疾病中的每一种，我们创建了两对图像，其中每对共享同一张胸部X线片但包含不同的外部照片。在匹配对中，胸部X线片和照片均包含提示同一疾病的发现（例如，肺内片状阴影和在水痘中见到的结痂性皮肤病变提示水痘肺炎）。在不匹配对中，照片描绘了另一种不会导致同一统一诊断的临床发现（例如，用普通痤疮替代结痂性皮肤病变）。合成照片生成允许临床发现发生变化，同时保持人物特征和摄影环境一致，从而减少混杂。在对三个前沿模型的研究中，我们发现模型在45-57.5%的不匹配对中幻觉出具有临床意义的照片发现，高于同一照片单独呈现时的25-37.5%。面对不匹配对时，模型倾向于忽略不匹配，转而幻觉出与X线片更匹配的发现（例如，将痤疮误读为结痂性皮肤病变，以证明水痘诊断合理）。Trick-or-Treat既展示了前沿模型医学推理中令人担忧的错误模式，也为在对抗性多模态评估中使用合成图像提供了概念验证。

title: From Vision to Context: A Review of Prompt-Driven Target Volume Segmentation in Radiotherapy
zh_title: 提示驱动的放疗靶区分割综述
summary: 综述提示驱动分割方法在放疗靶区分割中的应用，比较提示技术与相对纯图像基线的性能。
key_points: CTV边界由临床知识而非仅影像特征界定
比较不同提示技术及与纯图像基线性能
按DSC、95%豪斯多夫距离等指标评估
reason: 预印本综述，无原创数据与外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Accurate target volume (TV) segmentation is essential for radiotherapy (RT) planning but remains time-consuming. Moreover, the final contour depends on the expertise of the radiation oncologist. Although deep learning has improved medical image segmentation, image-only models cannot encode the clinical reasoning that governs TV delineation, particularly for the clinical target volume (CTV), where boundaries are defined by clinical knowledge rather than imaging features alone. Prompt-driven segmentation has recently emerged as a strategy to address this limitation. This work aims to review these approaches for RT TV segmentation with four objectives: (1) compare the different prompting techniques used; (2) compare their performance against image-only baselines; (3) assess how they are evaluated against standard metrics, including the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), 95th Hausdorff distance, sensitivity, precision, and clinical assessment; and (4) identify the gaps needed for clinical translation. We systematically searched PubMed, Embase, and arXiv for studies incorporating geometric, clinical text, or interactive prompts into deep learning models for RT TV delineation. Thirteen studies met the inclusion criteria, spanning head and neck, breast, prostate, lung, cervix, and rectal cancers. Seven studies used clinical text prompting, four used geometric prompting, and two used interactive prompting; three combined modalities. Reported DSC ranged from 0.67 to 0.93, compared to 0.65 to 0.91 for image-only baselines. None reported sensitivity or precision. Clinical text prompting appears well suited to CTV delineation. Evidence remains limited, and standardized prompt engineering and clinical validation are needed before these approaches can be translated into routine RT practice.
zh_abstract: 准确的目标体积（target volume，TV）分割对于放疗（radiotherapy，RT）计划至关重要，但仍然耗时。此外，最终轮廓取决于放射肿瘤科医师的专业知识。尽管深度学习改善了医学图像分割，但仅基于图像的模型无法编码支配 TV 勾画的临床推理，尤其是对临床靶体积（clinical target volume，CTV）而言，其边界由临床知识而非仅由影像特征界定。提示驱动的分割最近作为应对这一局限的策略出现。本工作旨在综述这些用于 RT TV 分割的方法，目标有四：(1) 比较所使用的不同提示技术；(2) 将其性能与仅基于图像的基线进行比较；(3) 评估其如何依据标准指标进行评价，包括 Dice 相似系数（Dice similarity coefficient，DSC）、第 95 百分位 Hausdorff 距离、灵敏度、精确率和临床评估；以及 (4) 识别临床转化所需的空白。我们系统检索了 PubMed、Embase 和 arXiv，纳入将几何提示、临床文本提示或交互式提示整合到深度学习模型中以进行 RT TV 勾画的研究。十三项研究符合纳入标准，涵盖头颈、乳腺、前列腺、肺、宫颈和直肠癌。七项研究使用临床文本提示，四项使用几何提示，两项使用交互式提示；三项研究结合了多种模态。报告的 DSC 范围为 0.67 至 0.93，而仅基于图像的基线为 0.65 至 0.91。均未报告灵敏度或精确率。临床文本提示似乎非常适合 CTV 勾画。证据仍然有限，在这些方法转化为常规 RT 实践之前，需要标准化的提示工程和临床验证。

title: Spatially and Compositionally Controlled Multimodal Glioblastoma MRI Synthesis with Latent Diffusion
zh_title: 潜扩散模型可控合成胶质母细胞瘤多模态MRI
summary: 提出两阶段潜扩散框架，按位置、范围与亚区成分生成可控的胶质母细胞瘤多模态MRI。
key_points: 分割LDM生成可控肿瘤图，ControlNet生成四模态
ControlNet使汇总FID由42.59降至36.12
生成分割质心误差0.842像素，含专家阅片研究
reason: 预印本生成方法，有指标对比但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Glioblastoma exhibits substantial heterogeneity in tumour morphology and composition across MRI modalities, often making available clinical datasets highly unbalanced in terms of patient pathologies. We propose a two-stage latent diffusion model (LDM) framework for the generation of explicitly controllable 2D glioblastoma MRI scans. First, a segmentation LDM generates tumour maps conditioned on location, spatial extent, axial position, and subregion composition. Second, a modality-conditioned LDM with ControlNet generates T1, T1Gd, T2, and FLAIR images adhering to the requested segmentation. On a held-out test set, generated segmentations achieved a mean centroid error of 0.842 pixels and a subregion proportion error of 0.795 percentage points. ControlNet improved Fréchet inception distance (FID) across all four modalities, reducing pooled FID from 42.59 to 36.12. An expert reader study yielded mean quality ratings of 6.60 for real images, 6.83 for ControlNet-generated images, and 6.77 for fully synthetic images.
zh_abstract: 胶质母细胞瘤在不同MRI模态间的肿瘤形态和组成上表现出显著异质性，常使可获得的临床数据集在患者病理方面高度不平衡。我们提出一种两阶段潜在扩散模型（latent diffusion model, LDM）框架，用于生成可显式控制的2D胶质母细胞瘤MRI扫描。首先，分割LDM根据位置、空间范围、轴位位置和亚区组成生成肿瘤图。其次，带有ControlNet的模态条件LDM生成符合所请求分割的T1、T1Gd、T2和FLAIR图像。在留出测试集上，生成的分割达到平均质心误差0.842像素和亚区比例误差0.795个百分点。ControlNet改善了所有四种模态的Fréchet inception distance（FID），将汇总FID从42.59降至36.12。一项专家读者研究得出的平均质量评分为：真实图像6.60，ControlNet生成图像6.83，完全合成图像6.77。

title: Bridging large language model-based agents and workflow languages for automated multi-perspective analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing data.
zh_title: LLM智能体结合工作流语言分析单细胞数据
summary: 构建LLM智能体与工作流语言结合的框架，自动生成、校验并并行执行单细胞RNA测序多视角分析流程。
key_points: 计划校验使意图达成率由0.061升至0.378
在3个数据集与3个LLM上评测
并行执行多视角流程并汇总结论
reason: 同行评审方法学工作，仅小规模内部评测，无外部验证
abstract: [Bioinformatics advances] In single-cell RNA sequencing data analysis, the same dataset can be examined from multiple complementary perspectives, each requiring different analytical strategies and potentially leading to distinct biological interpretations. Systematically exploring such diverse strategies in a reproducible and scalable manner remains challenging. We developed a framework combining large language model-based agents with workflow languages. Given an objective, the framework generates analytical strategies, converts each into a workflow plan, verifies that each plan reflects its intended strategy, executes accepted workflows in parallel, and integrates the outputs into a final report. Evaluation across three datasets and three large language models showed that plan validation improved the executable analysis intent fulfillment rate from 0.061 to 0.378. Diversity of analytical themes was established at as few as 10 generated strategies, while the number of distinct executable analysis paths grew continuously, reaching 59 unique paths at 100 generated strategies. Parallelization of both plan generation and workflow execution achieved up to a 29.9-fold speedup in workflow execution over sequential execution, with plan generation completing in near-constant time regardless of portfolio size. abstract: [Health policy (Amsterdam, Netherlands)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in health care to improve the quality of care, support clinical decision-making, and increase efficiency. As AI systems are integrated into healthcare workflows, they can also become involved in how work is managed, including directing tasks, coordinating workflows, monitoring activity, and evaluating performance. These managerial uses of digital and AI systems are commonly referred to as forms of algorithmic management. Such uses may contribute to the intended benefits of AI, but may also make work more standardised, measurable, and monitorable, potentially increasing managerial control, reducing professional autonomy, or intensifying work. Whether these consequences arise depends on how these systems are implemented and governed. Realising AI's potential in health care therefore requires explicit choices about how AI is used within healthcare organisations and how gains from automation are allocated, so that benefits for care are maximised while potential harms are limited.
zh_abstract: 【卫生政策（阿姆斯特丹，荷兰）】人工智能（Artificial Intelligence, AI）正越来越多地应用于医疗保健，以提高护理质量、支持临床决策并提高效率。随着 AI 系统整合到医疗保健工作流程中，它们也可能参与工作管理方式，包括指导任务、协调工作流程、监测活动和评估绩效。数字系统和 AI 系统的这些管理用途通常被称为算法管理形式。此类用途可能有助于实现 AI 的预期效益，但也可能使工作更加标准化、可测量和可监控，从而可能增加管理控制、降低专业自主性或加剧工作强度。这些后果是否出现取决于这些系统如何实施和治理。因此，要实现 AI 在医疗保健中的潜力，需要明确选择 AI 在医疗保健组织内的使用方式以及自动化收益如何分配，以便在最大化护理效益的同时限制潜在危害。

abstract: [Brain and behavior] This study aimed to develop an interpretable ClinicalBERT-based framework for mental health monitoring using structured clinical data. Because the Mental Health Diagnosis and Treatment Monitoring dataset contains structured patient attributes rather than free-text clinical narratives, a structured-to-text transformation module was used to convert the records into contextual descriptions suitable for ClinicalBERT. The proposed model was compared with Random Forest, XGBoost, Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT), TabTransformer, and a Deep Neural Network, and to strengthen the experimental comparison, contemporary tabular transformer models, including SAINT and FT-Transformer, were also evaluated. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Cross-validation, confidence interval analysis, statistical significance testing, and ablation experiments were conducted to examine the reliability of the results. SHAP and LIME were used to explain global feature contributions and individual predictions. ClinicalBERT achieved an accuracy of 90.2%, a precision of 90.5%, a recall of 90.4%, and an F1-score of 90.6%, outperforming all comparison models. The additional validation analyses supported the stability of the results. SHAP and LIME further identified the patient attributes that contributed most strongly to the model's predictions. The findings indicate that structured clinical records can be transformed into contextual representations for transformer-based mental health monitoring. The framework combines predictive performance with interpretable output, although its evaluation is currently limited to a single dataset. Further validation using multi-institutional and prospective data is required.

abstract: [Health affairs scholar] Legal epidemiology is a growing field wherein researchers examine the effects of health policies on health outcomes. Policy surveillance is a key part of the legal epidemiology process and leads to the creation of a legal dataset for econometric analyses. Policy surveillance includes conceptualizing the research scope, collecting legal data, and coding data to answer legal questions. Historically, policy surveillance has been slow and time-consuming, limiting timely information about the effects of health policies on health outcomes. Researchers are exploring the role of artificial intelligence using large language models (LLMs) to increase the efficiency and quality of the policy surveillance process. In this commentary, we describe potential uses of LLMs by researchers conducting policy surveillance as well as potential challenges that will need to be addressed before LLMs are widely used in the process. We also suggest areas for future research while emphasizing the need for development of guidelines for LLM use in policy surveillance.
zh_abstract: [Health affairs scholar] 法律流行病学是一个不断发展的领域，研究人员在其中考察卫生政策对健康结局的影响。政策监测是法律流行病学过程的关键部分，并促成为计量经济学分析创建法律数据集。政策监测包括构思研究范围、收集法律数据以及对数据编码以回答法律问题。历史上，政策监测一直缓慢且耗时，限制了对卫生政策影响健康结局的及时信息。研究人员正在探索使用大型语言模型（large language models，LLMs）的人工智能在提高政策监测过程效率和质量方面的作用。在本评论中，我们描述了开展政策监测的研究人员对 LLMs 的潜在用途，以及在 LLMs 广泛用于该过程之前需要解决的潜在挑战。我们还提出了未来研究领域，同时强调需要制定 LLMs 在政策监测中使用指南。

title: Generative artificial intelligence use and interpersonal educational interaction among nursing students: self-regulated learning as a statistical mediator.
zh_title: 护理学生生成式AI使用与教育互动关系
summary: 对1020名护理学生的横断面调查显示，生成式AI互动、教育互动与自主学习两两显著正相关，自主学习起统计中介作用。
key_points: 单所医科大学1020名护理学生问卷
三变量均呈显著正相关（P<0.01）
自主学习为统计中介，非因果结论
reason: 单中心横断面问卷，无对照与外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in psychology] Generative artificial intelligence (GAI) is reshaping health sciences education. For nursing students, educational interaction (EI), self-regulated learning (SRL), and GAI interaction are all particularly important. However, these relationships and their processes remain underexplored. A total of 1020 nursing students were recruited from one medical university in Hunan Province in China. The Demographics Questionnaire, the Chinese version of Student-GAI interaction scale, the Educational Interaction Scale, and the Self-regulated Learning Questionnaire were administered. SPSS 22.0 and AMOS 24.0 software were used to analyze the data. The mean scores of student-GAI interaction (SGI) and EI were 14.80 ± 2.27 and 70.90 ± 8.15, respectively. Significant positive relationships were found among all three variables (all P < 0.01). Both SGI (β = 0.256) and SRL (β = 0.520) positively were associated with EI (both P < 0.001). Furthermore, SGI showed a significant direct association with EI, with a direct effect value of 0.92 (P < 0.001). SRL statistically mediated the association between SGI and EI, with a significant indirect effect value of 0.44. The mediating effect represented 32.35% of the total effect (P < 0.001). Dimension-specific analyses revealed that the mediating effect was strongest for student-teacher interaction (45.41%) and student-content interaction (41.54%). SGI is positively associated with EI among nursing students, both directly and indirectly through SRL. Educational strategies that encourage effective GAI use and strengthen SRL may be associated with enhanced EI in nursing education.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in psychology] 生成式人工智能（generative artificial intelligence, GAI）正在重塑健康科学教育。对护理学生而言，教育互动（educational interaction, EI）、自我调节学习（self-regulated learning, SRL）和GAI互动都尤为重要。然而，这些关系及其过程仍未被充分探讨。从中国湖南省一所医科大学招募了1020名护理学生。施测了人口学问卷、中文版学生-GAI互动量表、教育互动量表和自我调节学习问卷。使用SPSS 22.0和AMOS 24.0软件分析数据。学生-GAI互动（student-GAI interaction, SGI）和EI的平均得分分别为14.80 ± 2.27和70.90 ± 8.15。三个变量之间均发现显著正相关（均P < 0.01）。SGI（β = 0.256）和SRL（β = 0.520）均与EI呈正相关（均P < 0.001）。此外，SGI与EI表现出显著直接关联，直接效应值为0.92（P < 0.001）。SRL在SGI与EI的关联中起统计学中介作用，间接效应值显著为0.44。中介效应占总效应的32.35%（P < 0.001）。维度特异性分析显示，中介效应在学生-教师互动（45.41%）和学生-内容互动（41.54%）中最强。在护理学生中，SGI与EI呈正相关，既存在直接关联，也通过SRL间接关联。鼓励有效使用GAI并加强SRL的教育策略可能与护理教育中EI的提升相关。

abstract: [Healthcare management forum] Telehealth is increasingly supported by connected devices, remote monitoring, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and distributed computing. These tools can extend access and support more responsive care, but their computational and environmental demands are rarely considered alongside clinical and organizational needs. We describe the current Canadian telehealth landscape, including remote care management, virtual visits, patient portals, and remote monitoring, and identify opportunities and gaps for AI integration. We then define Green AI in healthcare and explain how an IoT-fog-cloud architecture can support resource-aware telehealth. For health leaders, Green AI is not only an engineering issue. It affects procurement, infrastructure planning, workforce capacity, clinical workflow, environmental responsibility, and equity. Evaluation should consider clinical performance, resource use, organizational fit, and sustainability. Responsible AI-enabled telehealth requires more than technical performance. A Green AI perspective can help health organizations improve computational efficiency while maintaining patient safety, usable workflows, resilience, and equitable access.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare management forum] 远程医疗正日益得到联网设备、远程监测、人工智能（AI）和分布式计算的支持。这些工具可以扩大可及性并支持更具响应性的护理，但其计算和环境需求很少与临床和组织需求一并考虑。我们描述了当前加拿大远程医疗格局，包括远程护理管理、虚拟就诊、患者门户和远程监测，并识别了 AI 整合的机会和差距。然后，我们定义了医疗保健中的绿色 AI（Green AI），并解释了物联网-雾-云（IoT-fog-cloud）架构如何支持资源感知的远程医疗。对于医疗领导者而言，绿色 AI 不仅是工程问题。它影响采购、基础设施规划、劳动力能力、临床工作流程、环境责任和公平性。评估应考虑临床性能、资源使用、组织适配性和可持续性。负责任的 AI 赋能远程医疗需要的不仅是技术性能。绿色 AI 视角可以帮助医疗组织提高计算效率，同时维持患者安全、可用工作流程、韧性和公平可及。

title: Figure format and the accuracy of AI-assisted reconstruction of Kaplan-Meier survival data
zh_title: 图片格式对AI重建Kaplan-Meier生存数据准确性的影响
summary: 预印本比较矢量PDF与位图PNG输入下，语言模型重建Kaplan-Meier个体生存数据的误差差异。
key_points: 生成64组双臂模拟数据集
同一模型分别在矢量PDF与300dpi PNG下重建
以曲线误差与限制性平均生存时间误差比较
reason: 预印本方法学研究，模拟数据规模有限，结论偏工具性，属增量档
abstract: Reconstructing participant-level data from published Kaplan-Meier curves supports meta-analysis and other secondary survival analyses when original trial records are unavailable. Researchers may use original PDF figures or screenshots, which can look alike but retain different information. We assessed how converting vector figures to images affects reconstruction by a language model that can inspect files and execute code. We generated 64 independent two-arm datasets across four scenarios combining 100 or 1,000 participants per arm with proportional or crossing hazards. Each figure was supplied as a native vector PDF and a matched 300-dpi PNG to Opus 5.5 through Claude Code under the same instructions. Outcomes compared reconstructed records with the original observed records: time-averaged absolute curve error through 24 months, error in the between-group restricted mean survival time difference, and error in the Cox log-hazard ratio. Native PDFs had lower curve error in all 64 completed pairs, including replacements for incomplete runs. Mean errors were 0.000029 and 0.1047 percentage points for PDF and PNG, respectively; the paired difference was -0.1047 (95% confidence interval, -0.1194 to -0.0909). PNG errors in the restricted mean survival time difference and log-hazard ratio were small: mean absolute errors were 0.0084 months and 0.0027. Lower resolution and compression increased curve errors; embedding unchanged pixels in a PDF did not restore vector accuracy. Some PNG runs exceeded the instructed revision limit, so results describe the implemented workflow rather than performance under a strictly enforced limit. Preserving vector information improved reconstruction fidelity in this workflow, but the observed differences do not establish clinically consequential changes in treatment estimates. Validation against reported survival summaries and event counts remains necessary. Generalization to published clinical figures and other model workflows requires further evaluation.
zh_abstract: 当原始试验记录不可获得时，从已发表的Kaplan-Meier曲线重建参与者水平数据可支持荟萃分析和其他二次生存分析。研究人员可能使用原始PDF图或截图，它们看起来相似但保留的信息不同。我们评估了将矢量图转换为图像如何影响由一个可检查文件并执行代码的语言模型所进行的重建。我们在四种情景下生成了64个独立双臂数据集，这些情景组合了每臂100或1,000名参与者与比例风险或交叉风险。每张图均以原生矢量PDF和匹配的300-dpi PNG形式，在相同指令下通过Claude Code提供给Opus 5.5。结局将重建记录与原始观察记录进行比较：24个月内时间平均绝对曲线误差、组间限制性平均生存时间差异的误差，以及Cox对数风险比的误差。原生PDF在所有64个完成的配对中均具有更低的曲线误差，包括对未完成运行的替换。PDF和PNG的平均误差分别为0.000029和0.1047个百分点；配对差异为-0.1047（95%置信区间，-0.1194至-0.0909）。PNG在限制性平均生存时间差异和对数风险比方面的误差较小：平均绝对误差分别为0.0084个月和0.0027。较低分辨率和压缩增加了曲线误差；在PDF中嵌入未改变的像素并未恢复矢量准确性。一些PNG运行超出了指令规定的修订上限，因此结果描述的是实际实施的工作流程，而非在严格强制上限下的性能。在该工作流程中，保留矢量信息提高了重建保真度，但观察到的差异并不能确定治疗估计发生了具有临床意义的变化。仍有必要针对已报告的生存汇总和事件计数进行验证。推广到已发表的临床图和其他模型工作流程仍需进一步评估。

title: What Patients Say They Can't Access: Mining Cancer Screening Barriers from Online Communities
zh_title: 从在线社区挖掘癌症筛查障碍
summary: 预印本分析六个 Reddit 社区逾5.6万帖，对576条美国帖子编码归纳筛查障碍。
key_points: 数据为六个癌种 Reddit 社区超5.6万帖
流程含关键词过滤、分诊、开放编码
归纳结构性、信息性与心理社会性障碍

abstract: Cancer screening disparities persist across the U.S., yet the patient-reported barriers driving low uptake remain poorly characterized at scale. While clinical surveys capture structured responses, they miss the organic, unsolicited discourse where patients candidly describe real-world obstacles. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale analysis of over 56,000 posts across six cancer-specific Reddit communities to surface barriers to cancer screening among U.S. patients. We apply a pipeline combining keyword filtering, barrier triage, open coding, and codebook synthesis to systematically extract and categorize patient-reported barriers from 576 U.S.-located posts. Our qualitative analysis reveals recurring structural, informational, and psychosocial barriers that vary meaningfully by cancer type and community context. These findings lay the groundwork for future work aimed at proactively identifying and addressing barriers at scale - spanning a broader range of cancer types and populations - and informing the design of targeted interventions, navigator programs, and health system policies that translate patient-reported obstacles into actionable solutions.
zh_abstract: 美国各地的癌症筛查差异持续存在，但导致低参与率的患者报告障碍在大规模层面仍缺乏充分刻画。虽然临床调查捕获结构化回答，却遗漏了患者坦诚描述现实世界障碍的自发、非征询式讨论。在本文中，我们对六个特定癌症的 Reddit 社区中超过 56,000 条帖子进行了大规模分析，以揭示美国患者癌症筛查的障碍。我们应用了一个结合关键词过滤、障碍分诊、开放式编码和编码簿综合的流程，从 576 条位于美国的帖子中系统提取并归类患者报告的障碍。我们的定性分析揭示了反复出现的结构性、信息性和心理社会障碍，这些障碍因癌症类型和社区背景而存在有意义的差异。这些发现为未来工作奠定了基础，旨在主动大规模识别和解决障碍——涵盖更广泛的癌症类型和人群——并为设计有针对性的干预措施、导航员项目和卫生系统政策提供信息，从而将患者报告的障碍转化为可操作的解决方案。

title: Leveraging deep generative modelling at the agent level in discrete-event simulations
zh_title: 离散事件仿真中智能体级深度生成建模
summary: arXiv预印本用条件表格GAN替代多疾病仿真中道路伤害模块，运行时间缩短86.6%。
key_points: 在Thanzi La Onse多疾病智能体仿真中验证
以条件表格GAN替换道路伤害子模型
仿真运行时间提升86.6%（自助法95%区间）
reason: 预印本方法学改进，面向卫生政策仿真，证据有限
abstract: Emulators are often invoked to facilitate parameter inference in computationally intensive agent-based simulations (ABSs). Most approaches, however, require a large sample of pre-existing outputs on which such emulators can be trained. For computationally intensive simulations, this sample can be prohibitively expensive to generate. We propose a new approach to leverage emulators at the agent level in event-based ABSs to reduce the computational requirements of the simulation itself. We demonstrate this in a computationally intensive ``multi-disease'' ABS, Thanzi La Onse, which self-consistently simulates a wide range of medical conditions in a population. By applying conditional tabular generative adversarial networks to replace the modelling of one of the simulated causes of ill health, road traffic injuries (RTIs), we are able to improve its simulation run-time by 86.6% (95% bootstrap confidence interval [85.2, 88.1]), while recovering the evolution of cause-specific mean disability adjusted life years with a 13% error, despite the low assumed incidence of fatal RTIs (~2%). Crucially, we do so while retaining the full ABS framework, and correctly recovering multi-disease dynamics. This represents a crucial step towards enabling full-model emulators for very computationally intensive simulations, and making large ABS amenable to rigorous parameter inference and a full understanding of parameter sensitivity.
zh_abstract: 仿真器（Emulators）常被用于促进计算密集的基于智能体仿真（ABSs）中的参数推断。然而，大多数方法需要大量预先存在的输出样本，以便在此类仿真器上进行训练。对于计算密集的仿真，生成该样本可能成本高昂到难以承受。我们提出一种新方法，在事件型 ABS 中于智能体层面利用仿真器，以降低仿真本身的计算需求。我们在一个计算密集的“多疾病”ABS——Thanzi La Onse 中展示了这一点；该模型自洽地模拟人群中广泛的医疗状况。通过应用条件表格生成对抗网络来替代对其中一种被模拟的健康不良原因——道路交通伤害（RTIs）——的建模，我们能够将其仿真运行时间改善 86.6%（95% bootstrap 置信区间 [85.2, 88.1]），同时以 13% 的误差恢复特定病因平均伤残调整生命年的演变，尽管假定致死性 RTIs 的发生率较低（约 2%）。关键在于，我们在做到这一点的同时保留了完整的 ABS 框架，并正确恢复了多疾病动态。这代表着朝着为计算密集度极高的仿真实现全模型仿真器、并使大型 ABS 能够进行严格参数推断和全面理解参数敏感性迈出的关键一步。

title: TACT-KV: Tri-Axis Cosine Transform for Compressing Volumetric KV Caches in Medical VLMs
zh_title: TACT-KV：医学视觉语言模型三维KV缓存压缩
summary: 预印本提出免校准的三轴离散余弦变换KV缓存压缩方法，压缩3D医学影像视觉语言模型的内存占用。
key_points: 针对3D医学影像视觉语言模型的KV缓存内存瓶颈
沿三个解剖轴施加可分离三维离散余弦变换
按层以逆注水分配频域比特预算
reason: 纯效率优化的预印本方法，条目未见临床验证或对比结果
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) applied to 3D medical scans face a structural memory wall. A single CT or MRI volume produces tens of thousands of vision tokens, and the resulting key-value (KV) cache scales linearly with both batch and context. Existing KV compression methods operate on the cache's feature or token statistics, or apply 1D and 2D transforms, leaving the three-axis spatial structure in the cache unexploited. We propose TACT-KV (Tri-Axis Cosine Transform), a calibration-free KV compression method that exploits strong spatial correlations in visual KV states along all three anatomical axes of 3D scans. This correlation concentrates the KV cache energy under a frequency-domain transform. TACT-KV applies a separable 3D discrete cosine transform to the KV cache, allocates a per-layer bit budget across frequency bins via reverse water-filling (more bits to high-energy components), and quantizes each bin with a fixed scalar codebook. We derive a close-form relation: the distortion reduction from adaptive bit allocation is dominated by the spectral concentration of the transformed cache. Across six medical VLMs and two 3D CT benchmarks, TACT-KV achieves the lowest 1-bit prediction-flip rate on eleven of twelve model and dataset pairs in our main comparison. The same advantage reproduces on four general-purpose VLMs evaluated on video tasks, indicating that the benefit of exploiting three-axis structure generalizes beyond medical imaging. At equal high-bandwidth memory (HBM), TACT-KV scales the decoding batch size on a single GPU by up to $8\times$.
zh_abstract: 应用于3D医学扫描的视觉-语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）面临结构性内存墙。单个CT或MRI体数据会产生数万个视觉token，而由此产生的键值（KV）缓存会随批次和上下文二者线性扩展。现有KV压缩方法基于缓存的特征或token统计量进行操作，或应用一维和二维变换，从而使缓存中的三轴空间结构未被利用。我们提出TACT-KV（Tri-Axis Cosine Transform，三轴余弦变换），这是一种无需校准的KV压缩方法，利用3D扫描全部三个解剖轴方向上视觉KV状态中的强空间相关性。这种相关性在频域变换下使KV缓存能量集中。TACT-KV对KV缓存应用可分离三维离散余弦变换，通过反向注水在频率bin之间分配每层比特预算（为高能量分量分配更多比特），并用固定标量码本对每个bin进行量化。我们推导出一个闭式关系：自适应比特分配带来的失真降低主要由变换后缓存的频谱集中度主导。在六个医学VLM和两个3D CT基准上，TACT-KV在我们主要比较的十二个模型与数据集配对中的十一个上取得了最低的1比特预测翻转率。同样的优势在四个于视频任务上评估的通用VLM上得到重现，表明利用三轴结构的收益可推广到医学影像之外。在同等高带宽内存（HBM）下，TACT-KV将单GPU上的解码批次大小最多扩大至8×。

title: A Frame-Level View and Image-Quality Annotation Tool for Fetal Echocardiography: Comparison with Spreadsheet Annotation
zh_title: 胎儿超声心动图逐帧视图与质量标注工具
summary: 开发逐帧心脏切面与图像质量标注工具CAT，并与表格标注对比，随机交叉试验纳入6名医学生。

abstract: Objective: To develop the Cardiologist Annotation Tool (CAT) for frame-level cardiac view and image-quality annotation in fetal echocardiography and compare it with spreadsheet-based annotation. Methods: CAT provides cine playback, frame navigation, and keyboard-based labeling without manual frame-range entry. Experts annotated 25 studies using both methods, and spreadsheet annotations were audited for predefined data-entry errors. In a randomized crossover study, six medical students annotated two normal studies, one with each method, against an expert reference. Results: Among 1,746 spreadsheet-annotated files, 6.2% contained major or critical data-entry errors, more frequently in congenital heart disease than normal studies (10.9% vs 3.4%). CAT yielded more annotated view segments per clip (3.6 vs 1.5). Rates of labeled and correctly labeled frames per minute were 1.77 and 1.68 times those with spreadsheets, respectively (both P = 0.031), with gains in all six students. No detectable difference in view-label accuracy was observed. Conclusion: CAT eliminates manual frame-range entry and enables finer-grained, structured annotation of fetal echocardiography, providing a practical approach to preparing datasets for AI research.

abstract: Remote robot surgery and tele-ultrasound increasingly rely on real-time streaming under strict bandwidth constraints, making lossy compression unavoidable. Since the receiving end of these clinical pipelines is increasingly a machine rather than a human observer, codec selection must be guided by downstream task accuracy rather than perceptual fidelity. We evaluate three widely deployed codecs, H.264/AVC, HEVC, and AV1, on prostate ultrasound segmentation, reporting task-aware compression performance with region overlap (Dice) and boundary accuracy (HD95) as the quality metrics. To compare codecs fairly, we match their operating points at a common perceptual-quality (SSIM) level. We establish, per codec, the lowest bitrate that preserves acceptable segmentation accuracy, reporting the 5th-percentile Dice alongside the mean to expose worst-case degradation. All three codecs preserve segmentation quality (mean Dice $\geq$ 0.84) down to approximately 0.07-0.20 bits per voxel (bpv). Below this point, AV1's accuracy declines gradually, while H.264's drops sharply. As a result, H.264 needs 82% more bitrate than AV1 to reach the same region-overlap accuracy (Dice), and 104.7% more to reach the same boundary accuracy (HD95).
zh_abstract: 远程机器人手术和远程超声越来越依赖严格带宽限制下的实时流传输，这使得有损压缩不可避免。由于这些临床流程的接收端越来越多是机器而非人类观察者，编解码器的选择必须以下游任务准确率为导向，而不是以感知保真度为导向。我们在前列腺超声分割上评估三种广泛部署的编解码器：H.264/AVC、HEVC 和 AV1，并以区域重叠度（Dice）和边界准确率（HD95）作为质量指标，报告任务感知的压缩性能。为公平比较各编解码器，我们在共同感知质量（SSIM）水平上匹配其工作点。我们针对每种编解码器确定能够保持可接受分割准确率的最低比特率，并报告第 5 百分位 Dice 及均值，以揭示最坏情况下的退化。三种编解码器在低至约 0.07-0.20 比特/体素（bpv）时均能保持分割质量（平均 Dice $\geq$ 0.84）。低于该点后，AV1 的准确率逐渐下降，而 H.264 的准确率急剧下降。因此，为达到相同的区域重叠准确率（Dice），H.264 所需比特率比 AV1 高 82%；为达到相同的边界准确率（HD95），H.264 所需比特率比 AV1 高 104.7%。

abstract: EEG extended-source imaging aims to localize active cortical regions and characterize their spatial extent, yet supervised inverse networks typically depend on synthetic EEG-source pairs and may be sensitive to synthetic-to-real mismatch. We propose a physics-informed self-supervised implicit neural representation (INR) framework for spatial source reconstruction without paired source labels or simulation-based supervised pretraining. The lead field matrix encodes the source-to-sensor volume-conduction model and constrains the INR through agreement between predicted and measured EEG. Cortical current density is modeled as a continuous coordinate-conditioned field. A classical inverse estimate provides warm initialization and spatial constraints on source activity, while patch-integrated projection maps the field to discrete source coefficients for forward modeling. Simulations with varying noise levels, source counts, and source extents showed the clearest advantage in identifying active cortical regions, particularly for multiple and larger sources. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations using real EEG recordings from epilepsy patients and intracranial stimulation experiments further supported the feasibility of the framework for source imaging. These findings suggest the potential of physics-informed self-supervised INR for extended-source imaging.
zh_abstract: EEG 扩展源成像旨在定位活跃皮层区域并表征其空间范围，然而监督式逆网络通常依赖合成的 EEG-源配对，且可能对合成到真实的失配敏感。我们提出一种物理信息自监督隐式神经表示（INR）框架，用于无需配对源标签或基于仿真的监督预训练的空间源重建。导联场矩阵编码源到传感器的容积传导模型，并通过预测 EEG 与实测 EEG 之间的一致性约束 INR。皮层电流密度被建模为连续的坐标条件场。经典逆估计提供热初始化以及对源活动的空间约束，而分块集成投影将场映射为离散源系数以进行前向建模。在不同噪声水平、源数量和源范围下的仿真显示，该方法在识别活跃皮层区域方面具有最明显优势，尤其是对多个源和较大源。使用癫痫患者真实 EEG 记录和颅内刺激实验进行的定量与定性评估进一步支持了该框架用于源成像的可行性。这些发现表明，物理信息自监督 INR 在扩展源成像方面具有潜力。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ruijin Hospital; conditions: Pancreatic Mucinous Cystic Neoplasm, Pancreatic Serous Cystic Neoplasm, Pancreatic Pseudocyst; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 400; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Pancreatic mucinous cystic neoplasms (MCNs), serous cystic neoplasms (SCNs), and pancreatic pseudocysts (PPCs) often exhibit overlapping imaging features on endoscopic ultrasound (EUS). This study aims to develop and validate an artificial intelligence (AI) model that integrates EUS images and clinical features to differentiate MCNs, SCNs, and PPCs. The study is designed as an ambispective observational diagnostic study consisting of retrospective model development, prospective temporal validation, and a reader study involving EUS physicians. abstract: [Computational biology and chemistry] Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis explains the histological pattern of injury seen through light microscopy in kidney biopsy specimens and is the end result of different injuries to podocytes. The clinical classification of patients by FSGS lesion is challenging because of a broad spectrum of etiologies, limited understanding of pathophysiology, and poor correlation among histopathology, treatment response, and clinical outcomes. Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis is a problematic process to detect lesions, with low and late analysis of the absence of initial symptoms, and a challenging position of specific markers. However, Histopathological and genomic Data in Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) are significantly used in multiple research applications, but they face several limitations that restrict the efficiency of experimental analysis. This review systematically analyzed recent enhancements in biopsy-based analysis and deep learning models for FSGS, with specific emphasis on different mechanisms. Moreover, this review analyzed different strategies, namely kidney transplantation, pathogenesis to therapeutic approaches, transformer-based architectures, glomerular segmentation methodologies, multitasking strategy classification, and gene expression analysis for FSGS. This review analysis includes 121 research papers, which are selected and analyzed for glomerular segmentation, gene expression, clinical outcomes, lesion classification, and disease recurrence prediction. Based on the recent research frameworks, it explicitly states the performance analysis, benefits, as well as challenges of FSGS. The article presents details of a new dataset and future directions for improving the majority of nephropathology diagnoses previously available through the use of integrated approaches that utilize both histopathology and genomics, enhancing future research direction in FSGS.
zh_abstract: [Computational biology and chemistry] 局灶节段性肾小球硬化（focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, FSGS）解释了肾活检标本中经光学显微镜观察到的组织学损伤模式，并且是足细胞受到不同损伤后的最终结果。根据FSGS病变对患者进行临床分类具有挑战性，原因包括病因谱广泛、对病理生理学的理解有限，以及组织病理学、治疗反应和临床结局之间相关性较差。局灶节段性肾小球硬化是一个检测病变存在问题的过程，由于缺乏初期症状，其分析率低且分析较晚，并且特异性标志物处于具有挑战性的位置。然而，局灶节段性肾小球硬化（FSGS）中的组织病理学和基因组学数据被大量用于多种研究应用，但它们面临若干限制，制约了实验分析的效率。本综述系统分析了基于活检的分析和用于FSGS的深度学习模型的最新进展，特别强调不同机制。此外，本综述分析了不同策略，即肾移植、从发病机制到治疗方法、基于Transformer的架构、肾小球分割方法、多任务策略分类以及FSGS的基因表达分析。本综述分析纳入121篇研究论文，这些论文被选择并分析用于肾小球分割、基因表达、临床结局、病变分类和疾病复发预测。基于近期研究框架，本文明确阐述了FSGS的性能分析、优势以及挑战。本文详细介绍了一个新数据集，并提出了未来方向，以改进此前通过同时利用组织病理学和基因组学的整合方法所能获得的多数肾脏病理诊断，从而增强FSGS的未来研究方向。

abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] The rapid emergence of antimicrobial resistance has created an urgent need for diagnostic technologies capable of rapidly identifying resistant phenotypes and informing precision antimicrobial therapy. Conventional antimicrobial susceptibility testing methods remain clinically reliable; however, they are limited by relatively long turnaround times and restricted physiological resolution. In recent years, vibrational spectroscopy techniques have emerged as promising platforms for rapid phenotypic microbiology because they generate label-free biochemical fingerprints associated with proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and membrane biomolecules. When integrated with machine learning and artificial intelligence, these technologies could provide highly sensitive tools for rapid bacterial classification, resistance prediction, and monitoring of dynamic physiological adaptation during antibiotic exposure. This review discusses the integration of chemometrics, machine learning, and deep learning algorithms with spectroscopic datasets, emphasizing both predictive performance and biological interpretability. It is highly useful for bacterial identification, biochemical characterization, and resistance profiling across multiple microbial species. Major controversies regarding genotype-versus-phenotype diagnostics, reproducibility, standardization, and AI explainability are also examined. Finally, we highlight current research gaps and future directions, including single-cell spectroscopy, multimodal phenotyping, explainable AI frameworks, and approaches in systems microbiology. Taken together, the available evidence indicates that integrating vibrational spectroscopy with artificial intelligence could substantially reshape future antimicrobial resistance diagnostics and mechanistic microbiology.

title: Application of Machine Learning and Deep Learning in diagnosis Covid19
zh_title: 机器学习与深度学习用于COVID-19诊断预测
summary: 预印本用两批COVID-19住院队列（阿尔及利亚80例、法国99例）比较五种机器学习模型预测死亡、ICU入住与临床转归。
key_points: 两队列合计179例，样本量小
比较LR、KNN、CART、NB、SVM五种分类器
预测死亡、ICU入住与病情改善或恶化
reason: 预印本、单中心小样本、无外部验证与临床结局影响，属增量档
abstract: Predicting the progression of COVID-19 in hospitalised patients was an important challenge during the pandemic, particularly when healthcare resources were limited. This study investigates the use of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models to predict three clinical outcomes: death, admission to the intensive care unit (ICU), and clinical status (improvement or worsening). The study uses two patient datasets: an Algerian cohort of 80 patients from the Internal Medicine Department of the University Hospital Centre of Constantine, collected between July and August 2020, and a French cohort of 99 patients collected between March and May 2020. Five ML classifiers were evaluated: logistic regression (LR), k-nearest neighbours (KNN), classification and regression trees (CART), Naive Bayes (NB), and support vector machines (SVM). Their performance was examined in combination with three feature-selection methods: analysis of variance (ANOVA), mutual information (MI), and recursive feature elimination (RFE). The results were also compared with multilayer perceptron (MLP) models using one to five hidden layers. Model evaluation included 30 repetitions of five-fold cross-validation on the training data, followed by evaluation on a separate hold-out test set. The results showed that selecting 20 features generally provided better cross-validated accuracy than selecting 30 features or using the full feature set. The best-performing classifier-feature-selection combination varied across the six dataset-outcome tasks. LR combined with RFE was selected for three tasks, LR combined with ANOVA for one task, and CART combined with ANOVA for two tasks. The selected ML models achieved test-set accuracies ranging from 0.47 to 0.95 and higher accuracy than the average MLP results in five of the six tasks. These findings suggest that ML methods can be useful for exploring clinical outcomes in hospitalised COVID-19 patients. However, the small sample sizes and limitations of the available data mean that the results should be interpreted with caution. Further evaluation using larger and independent patient datasets is needed before these models can be considered for clinical use.
zh_abstract: 预测住院COVID-19患者的疾病进展是大流行期间的一项重要挑战，尤其是在医疗资源有限时。本研究探讨使用机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）模型预测三项临床结局：死亡、入住重症监护病房（ICU）以及临床状态（改善或恶化）。研究使用两个患者数据集：一个阿尔及利亚队列，来自君士坦丁大学医院中心内科的80名患者，收集于2020年7月至8月；以及一个法国队列，99名患者，收集于2020年3月至5月。评估了五种ML分类器：逻辑回归（LR）、k近邻（KNN）、分类与回归树（CART）、朴素贝叶斯（NB）和支持向量机（SVM）。将其性能与三种特征选择方法结合进行检查：方差分析（ANOVA）、互信息（MI）和递归特征消除（RFE）。结果还与使用1至5个隐藏层的多层感知机（MLP）模型进行比较。模型评估包括在训练数据上进行30次重复的五折交叉验证，随后在单独的留出测试集上评估。结果显示，选择20个特征通常比选择30个特征或使用完整特征集提供更好的交叉验证准确率。表现最佳的分类器-特征选择组合在六项数据集-结局任务中各不相同。LR联合RFE被选用于三项任务，LR联合ANOVA用于一项任务，CART联合ANOVA用于两项任务。所选ML模型在测试集上的准确率范围为0.47至0.95，并且在六项任务中的五项中准确率高于MLP的平均结果。这些发现表明，ML方法可用于探索住院COVID-19患者的临床结局。然而，样本量小和可用数据的局限性意味着应谨慎解释结果。在将这些模型考虑用于临床之前，需要使用更大且独立的患者数据集进行进一步评估。

title: Enhanced MRI brain tumor detection using deep learning in conjunction with explainable AI SHAP based diverse and multi feature analysis
zh_title: 多特征融合与SHAP可解释的MRI脑肿瘤检测
summary: arXiv预印本结合LBP、Gabor、小波、CNN等多种特征与五种分类器做MRI脑肿瘤检测，并用SHAP解释。
key_points: 组合手工特征与CNN特征
比较KNN、随机森林、SVC、PNN与CNN
报告LBP+SVC+CNN的准确率与特异度较高
reason: 预印本，仅报告指标提升、无外部验证或对照设计，属增量档
abstract: Recent innovations in medical imaging have markedly improved brain tumor identification, surpassing conventional diagnostic approaches that suffer from low resolution, radiation exposure, and limited contrast. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is pivotal in precise and accurate tumor characterization owing to its high-resolution, non-invasive nature. This study investigates the synergy among multiple feature representation schemes such as local Binary Patterns (LBP), Gabor filters, Discrete Wavelet Transform, Fast Fourier Transform, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Gray-Level Run Length Matrix alongside five learning algorithms namely: k-nearest Neighbor, Random Forest, Support Vector Classifier (SVC), and probabilistic neural network (PNN), and CNN. Empirical findings indicate that LBP in conjunction with SVC and CNN obtained high specificity and accuracy, rendering it a promising method for MRI-based tumor diagnosis. Further to investigate the contribution of LBP, Statistical analysis chi-square and p-value tests are used to confirm the significant impact of LBP feature space for identification of brain Tumor. In addition, The SHAP analysis was used to identify the most important features in classification. In a small dataset, CNN obtained 97.8% accuracy while SVC yielded 98.06% accuracy. In subsequent analysis, a large benchmark dataset is also utilized to evaluate the performance of learning algorithms in order to investigate the generalization power of the proposed model. CNN achieves the highest accuracy of 98.9%, followed by SVC at 96.7%. These results highlight CNN's effectiveness in automated, high-precision tumor diagnosis. zh_abstract: 医学影像学的最新创新显著改善了脑肿瘤识别，超越了传统诊断方法，后者存在分辨率低、辐射暴露和对比度有限的问题。磁共振成像（MRI）因其高分辨率、无创的特性，在精确和准确的肿瘤表征中至关重要。本研究探讨多种特征表示方案的协同作用，如局部二值模式（LBP）、Gabor滤波器、离散小波变换、快速傅里叶变换、卷积神经网络（CNN）和灰度游程长度矩阵，以及五种学习算法，即：k近邻、随机森林、支持向量分类器（SVC）、概率神经网络（PNN）和CNN。实证结果表明，LBP与SVC和CNN结合获得了高特异性和准确性，使其成为基于MRI的肿瘤诊断的一种有前景的方法。为进一步研究LBP的贡献，使用卡方和p值检验的统计分析来确认LBP特征空间对脑肿瘤识别的显著影响。此外，SHAP分析用于识别分类中最重要的特征。在小数据集中，CNN获得了97.8%的准确率，而SVC产生了98.06%的准确率。在随后的分析中，还使用了一个大型基准数据集来评估学习算法的性能，以研究所提出模型的泛化能力。CNN达到了最高的98.9%准确率，其次是SVC的96.7%。这些结果突显了CNN在自动化、高精度肿瘤诊断中的有效性。代码：https://github.com/asifrahman557/BrainTumorDetection
